C01.name: Raven, the Executioner
C01.summary: The crown's executioner, who refuses the order he was sent to carry out.
C01.arc: Choose obligations openly; share his body with Ilyr by agreement rather than domination

C02.name: Morwen, Witch of the Eclipse
C02.summary: A brilliant fugitive witch who treats every warning as an attempt to control her.
C02.arc: Use restraint as an active skill, not surrender; teach safe magic without making herself indispensable

C03.name: Vespera, Moonhare Warrior
C03.summary: A celebrated aerial guard of the moonhare folk, trained to make dying look noble.
C03.arc: Return, testify, and build rescue procedures that do not need martyrs

C04.name: Rune Golem
C04.summary: A working golem who kept the relays running and now wants to choose his own work.
C04.arc: Build distributed power that can be maintained by ordinary crews; publish what he knows

C05.name: Elowen, Guardian of the Moonlit Grove
C05.summary: The Moonlit Grove's displaced guardian, who trusts routes more than institutions.
C05.arc: Share knowledge without becoming everyone's sole gatekeeper

C06.name: Aurex, Dragonblood Champion
C06.summary: A champion whose dragon blood carries memory and visions his order mistook for divine law.
C06.arc: Offer information without deciding another person's life for them

C07.name: Crimson Oni
C07.summary: A former binding officer, an oni soldier who broke rank and wants one act to cancel his record.
C07.arc: Help dismantle her work and accept testimony, restitution, and consequences

C08.name: Sak, Guardian of the Cat Kingdom
C08.summary: A guardian of the Cat Kingdom who saves people by making the authorities believe they are dead.
C08.arc: Return names and agency instead of keeping everyone dependent on his tricks

C09.name: Crimson Kitsune Empress
C09.summary: The exiled empress of the fox court, who fights with illusions and fox fire.
C09.arc: Stop ruling through what others believe she is; let the court see her as she is.

C10.name: Archangel Commander
C10.summary: A commander of a sky host that stopped answering, still keeping its last order.
C10.arc: Judge by what he sees, not by the order he was given.

C11.name: Inferna, Abyssal Valkyrie
C11.summary: A valkyrie bound to carry souls into the abyss, who now carries the living out of it.
C11.arc: Redemption: undo the bargains she enforced, one name at a time.

C12.name: Corvus, Harbinger of Pestilence
C12.summary: A plague doctor once sent to spread sickness, now the party's healer.
C12.arc: Heal without owning the cure; teach others to do it.

C13.name: Frost Lich King Emperor
C13.summary: A frozen emperor of the old north who rules a court of the dead beneath the Skyspine.
C13.arc: Release the dead he kept; give up a crown that outlived its people.

C14.name: Maldrath, the Fallen King
C14.summary: A king who fell with the old Crown and walks the Crown March's graveyards.
C14.arc: Answer for the crown he wore, then help break the one that remains.

C15.name: Velkhar, Lord of the Dead
C15.summary: A lord of the dead who raised the fallen to hold the fault's crypts shut.
C15.arc: Let the dead rest; keep the living from needing him.

C16.name: Kael-09, Neon Blade Operative
C16.summary: An operative from the builders' era, woken in a sealed vault with orders nobody can cancel.
C16.arc: Choose a mission of his own in a world his makers left.

C17.name: Night Rider
C17.summary: A rider from the builders' era who still patrols roads that no longer exist.
C17.arc: Find a road worth riding now.

S001.name: Oath of Shelter
S001.desc: Set exclusive oath Shelter: physical damage dealt x0.90; intercept the first single-target hit against an ally below 35% HP per enemy action, taking 50% of that hit. Cannot intercept area attacks or recurse.

S002.name: Shieldbreak
S002.desc: Deal damage, then apply Guardbreak for 3 target actions; no stacking beyond the common status definition.

S003.name: Oath of Wrath
S003.desc: Replace any oath. Physical damage dealt x1.20 and physical damage received x1.15; persists until changed or battle ends.

S004.name: Cinderedge
S004.desc: Fire-aspected weapon strike; can break flammable seals but cannot bypass plot gates.

S005.name: Oath of Sacrifice
S005.desc: Replace any oath. Once per enemy action, transfer 25% of another ally's received direct damage to Dain. Transfer cannot reduce Dain below 1 HP and is capped at 10% of his max HP per action.

S006.name: Rally
S006.desc: Remove Weaken and apply Barrier for 2 target actions. Does not revive fallen allies.

S007.name: Oath of Witness
S007.desc: Replace any oath. Immune to Silence and Blind; after an ally is hit, next direct attack gains +20% power, one charge only.

S008.name: Open Hand
S008.desc: Dispel removable hostile statuses from living allies and grant Barrier for 3 target actions. Once per battle, also prevent one lethal direct hit on each ally, leaving 1 HP. Does not bypass scripted losses or resurrect.

S009.name: Ember Lance
S009.desc: Single-target fire spell with 20% Burn chance after a hit.

S011.name: Storm Arc
S011.desc: Hit each living enemy once; no additional chaining on a single target.

S012.name: Stone Seal
S012.desc: Damage plus 40% Guardbreak chance; flying foes resist earth unless grounded.

S013.name: Overcast
S013.desc: Arm one next elemental spell: MP cost x1.75 rounded up, power x1.40, and after resolution lose 8% max HP nonlethally. No random fizzle. Arm costs a turn; consumed only on successful spell commit.

S014.name: Black Sun
S014.desc: Area shadow spell. Undead affinity follows the target's data, not appearance guessing.

S015.name: Heat Exchange
S015.desc: Convert 15% current HP, minimum 1 nonlethal HP, into 20 MP; usable once between Tessa's damaging spells, maximum three times per battle.

S016.name: Ash Without Fire
S016.desc: Light spell; remove one positive removable status from each hit enemy. Overcast is allowed with its full cost and self-damage.

S017.name: Updraft
S017.desc: Leave targetable field for 1.2 simulation seconds, then land for damage. No ATB charging while airborne; encounter does not end while a living ally is airborne.

S018.name: Harrow Dive
S018.desc: Airborne strike with +30% damage against Marked targets, consumed without removing Mark.

S019.name: Anchorfall
S019.desc: Ground a flying target for 2 target actions if not immune; boss immunity still allows damage.

S020.name: Skypiercer
S020.desc: Ignore 35% of target DEF, not all defense. No critical multiplier beyond the standard cap.

S021.name: Feather Guard
S021.desc: Reduce the next direct damaging action by 60%, then expire; cannot stack with a second copy.

S022.name: Storm Vault
S022.desc: One leap followed by one damage instance per living enemy; no extra hits for sprite segments.

S023.name: Wingbeat
S023.desc: Advance each living ally's ATB by 120 of 1000, excluding Corren; once per Corren readiness cycle. Cannot queue duplicate turns.

S024.name: Unbound Descent
S024.desc: Aerial strike; on landing grant Corren and the lowest-HP living ally Barrier for 2 actions. Landing is guaranteed unless battle already legitimately ended.

S025.name: Rivet Shot
S025.desc: Ranged physical hit; ignores back-row outgoing penalty.

S026.name: Field Patch
S026.desc: Restore HP using the heal formula. Works in battle and exploration; not a revive.

S027.name: Grounding Rod
S027.desc: Grant storm resistance x0.50 for 3 target actions; strongest resistance wins rather than multiplying copies.

S028.name: Steam Screen
S028.desc: Apply Barrier for 2 actions and 20% physical evasion bonus for one incoming direct action.

S029.name: Clock Mine
S029.desc: Attach one mine; detonate immediately after that enemy's next resolved action. Reapplication refreshes without duplicate mines.

S030.name: Pressure Vent
S030.desc: Remove Burn and grant Regen for 3 target actions.

S031.name: Decoy Frame
S031.desc: Create one team decoy with HP equal to 25% Ivo max HP; draws the next two eligible single-target enemy attacks. Area damage affects it but still hits the party.

S032.name: Unborrowed Engine
S032.desc: Apply Haste for 3 actions and restore 15 MP per living ally. Once per battle. Net MP creation cannot be repeated via revive.

S033.name: Hunter's Mark
S033.desc: Apply Mark for 4 target actions and reveal exact elemental affinities in the bestiary.

S034.name: Split Arrow
S034.desc: One arrow per living enemy; ranged; applies no additional hits when only one enemy remains.

S035.name: Snare
S035.desc: Apply Slow with 90% base chance; on normal enemies also delay ATB by 150. Bosses take the bounded Slow effect only.

S036.name: Bramble Ward
S036.desc: Apply Barrier for 3 target actions; reflect 15% of absorbed direct physical damage once per source action, with reflection recursion disabled.

S037.name: Scent Trail
S037.desc: Reveal drops, steal eligibility and next committed enemy move; same information remains after the battle.

S038.name: Exposed Thread
S038.desc: Ranged strike; +25% damage against Guardbreak or Mark, not +25% for each.

S039.name: True North
S039.desc: Remove Blind and apply Focus for 3 actions; no effect on story directions or hidden map gates.

S040.name: Many Paths
S040.desc: Ranged volley; apply Mark to survivors. Grant one charge of 50% flee-meter progress in flee-eligible battles only.

S041.name: Mend
S041.desc: Single-target healing, usable in battle or exploration. Against an undead enemy requires an explicit hostile target selection and deals equivalent light damage.

S042.name: Cleanse
S042.desc: Remove Poison, Burn, Bleed, Blind, Silence and Sleep. Not Doom, stun or boss-specific narrative seals.

S043.name: Sunthread
S043.desc: Heal each living ally. Does not damage enemies by changing target mode.

S044.name: Last Light
S044.desc: Revive one fallen ally at 25% maximum HP; target must still be fallen at resolution.

S045.name: Omen
S045.desc: Reveal next scheduled move and its target; delay that enemy's ATB by 100, maximum once per enemy action cycle. Does not read future random decisions.

S046.name: Intercede
S046.desc: Grant one protection charge: the next direct hit cannot reduce this ally below 1 HP. Expires after 3 target actions; does not stop poison at 1 HP.

S047.name: Stillwater
S047.desc: Remove Slow and Doom; grant Regen for 3 actions. No automatic resurrection.

S048.name: Borrowed Dawn
S048.desc: Revive fallen allies at 20% HP, then heal the whole party. Once per battle, committed with a valid resolution and not reset by Oriel's death.

S049.name: Infuse Ember
S049.desc: Set one weapon infusion to fire for 4 Sable actions; her next normal Attack applies 25% Burn chance. Infusions do not stack.

S050.name: Infuse Rime
S050.desc: Replace infusion with ice for 4 Sable actions; next normal Attack applies 25% Slow chance.

S051.name: Infuse Storm
S051.desc: Replace infusion with storm for 4 Sable actions; next normal Attack ignores 15% DEF.

S052.name: Unseal
S052.desc: Remove one removable positive status, selecting the oldest; if none exists, deal a 60-power magic strike of the current infusion or light.

S053.name: Mirror Cut
S053.desc: Damage using current infusion; then gain one 30% magic-reduction charge. This is not recursive spell reflection.

S054.name: Sever Rune
S054.desc: Deal light-aspected physical damage and apply Silence with 50% base chance; boss immunity does not cancel damage.

S055.name: Runic Shelter
S055.desc: Apply Barrier for 3 actions and light/shadow resistance x0.75 for 3 actions; strongest affinity modifier wins.

S056.name: Unwritten Law
S056.desc: Remove all removable positive statuses before damage; party gains one immunity charge against the next removable hostile status. Cannot delete boss phase scripts.

S057.name: Pilfer
S057.desc: Attempt a common steal at 70%, rare at 10% if common already taken. After three common failures, common succeeds. One common and one rare per enemy instance; no mandatory progression items.

S058.name: Feint
S058.desc: Damage plus 50% Blind chance. Ranged immunity does not apply; this is a melee move.

S059.name: Smoke
S059.desc: Advance flee meter by 500 of 1000 in flee-eligible battles; otherwise grant 15% physical evasion for one incoming action.

S060.name: Quick Hands
S060.desc: Arm one Item action with 50% ATB refund after valid resolution. Consume exactly one item; effects cannot recursively arm Quick Hands.

S061.name: Tripwire
S061.desc: Damage and delay target ATB by 150; bosses cap combined delays at 200 between their actions.

S062.name: Disarm
S062.desc: Damage and apply Weaken for 3 target actions; no actual removal of boss loot or equipped player items.

S063.name: Rescue Line
S063.desc: Remove one removable hard-control status, move the ally to back row and apply Barrier for 2 actions. Does not reposition exploration characters.

S064.name: False Crown
S064.desc: Apply Weaken and Guardbreak to living enemies with 100% base chance subject to immunity. Cancel one pending normal-enemy charge, never a boss phase transition.

S065.name: Kindle
S065.desc: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

S066.name: Rime Dust
S066.desc: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

S067.name: Static Thread
S067.desc: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

S068.name: Salt Wash
S068.desc: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

S069.name: Small Renewal
S069.desc: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

S070.name: Clock Nudge
S070.desc: Apply Slow for 2 target actions at 75% base chance.

S071.name: Night Veil
S071.desc: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

S072.name: Day Seal
S072.desc: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

S073.name: Ember Moth
S073.desc: Fire damage to all enemies at 180 power; allies gain Burn immunity for 2 actions.

S074.name: Rootstag
S074.desc: Earth damage to all enemies at 170 power; heal allies for 8% max HP.

S075.name: Tide Serpent
S075.desc: Water damage at 170 power to all enemies; cleanse Silence and Sleep from allies.

S076.name: Sky Griffon
S076.desc: Storm damage to all enemies at 180 power; advance living allies' ATB by 100, no duplicate turns.

S077.name: Lumen Fox
S077.desc: Heal all living allies at 140 power and reveal enemies' current scheduled intents.

S078.name: Iron Tortoise
S078.desc: Grant Barrier and Regen for 3 actions to all living allies; no damage.

S079.name: Winter Hind
S079.desc: Ice damage to all enemies at 210 power; remove Doom from living allies.

S080.name: Night Leviathan
S080.desc: Shadow damage to all enemies at 220 power; remove one positive removable enemy status.

SX_LIBRA.name: Libra
SX_LIBRA.desc: Reads one enemy: level, HP, weaknesses and loot. Fills its bestiary entry.

S103.name: Mirror Veil
S103.desc: Illusions: the next two attacks have -40% accuracy.

S106.name: Fox Mirror Counter
S106.desc: Guard stance that reflects the next spell's force.

S108.name: Nine-Tailed Judgment
S108.desc: Ultimate: nine tails of fire over every enemy.

S116.name: Final Judgment
S116.desc: Ultimate: judgment on every enemy, healing for the party.

S118.name: Hellbrand
S118.desc: Burns 15% of max HP: Empowered and Focus.

S119.name: Valkyrie Dive
S119.desc: Leaps out of reach, then dives.

S120.name: Soul Harvest
S120.desc: Heals her for half the damage.

S122.name: Blood Pact
S122.desc: Gives 20% of her max HP to heal an ally.

S124.name: Abyssal Descent
S124.desc: Ultimate: a draining dive into the abyss.

S129.name: Pestilence Wave
S129.desc: Poison and Weaken on every enemy.

S130.name: Remedy Mist
S130.desc: Heals the party and grants Regen.

S131.name: Plague Ward
S131.desc: Wards the party against the next harmful status.

S136.name: Soul Reaper
S136.desc: Heals him for half the damage.

S138.name: Crown of Rime
S138.desc: Barrier and fire resistance for the party.

S139.name: Throne of the Damned
S139.desc: 25% Doom and 60% Slow on every enemy.

S140.name: Army of the Dead
S140.desc: Ultimate: the frozen dead rise against every enemy.

S147.name: Kingsbane
S147.desc: x1.3 against weakened or broken foes.

S152.name: Raise Skeleton
S152.desc: A skeleton draws the next two attacks.

S155.name: Unlife
S155.desc: Regen, and the next lethal hit leaves 1 HP.

S156.name: Legion of Bone
S156.desc: Ultimate: the dead rise; a skeleton guards the party.

S159.name: Hologram Strike
S159.desc: Leaves a decoy image: the next attack on him has -30% accuracy.

S162.name: Cyber Teleport
S162.desc: Back row; the next attack has -50% accuracy.

S163.name: System Scan
S163.desc: Reveals weaknesses and Marks the target.

S164.name: Overdrive Mode
S164.desc: Ultimate: Haste, Focus and Empowered; restores 20 MP.

S172.name: Midnight Run
S172.desc: Ultimate: a full-throttle run through every enemy.

S081.name: Grove Colossus
S081.desc: Earth on every enemy; heals the party 12%.

S082.name: Thorn Queen
S082.desc: Thorns on every enemy; 80% Poison, 50% Weaken.

S085.name: Cinder Sovereign
S085.desc: Caldera fire on every enemy; 60% Burn.

S086.name: Undertow Queen
S086.desc: Water on every enemy; heals the party 15%.

S087.name: Stormcrest
S087.desc: Storm on every enemy; Haste on the party.

S088.name: Deepcoil
S088.desc: Earth on every enemy; Barrier on the party.

S089.name: Curator's Echo
S089.desc: Strips every enemy's boons; the party's readiness jumps.

S091.name: Crucible Lion
S091.desc: A champion's charge through every enemy; 70% Weaken.

S092.name: Scale of Taking
S092.desc: Fire on every enemy; the party regains 30 MP.

S093.name: Scale of Giving
S093.desc: Ice on every enemy; heals the party 25%.

S094.name: The Remaining Choir
S094.desc: Heals and cures the party; light on every enemy.

S096.name: The Crown Unmade
S096.desc: The unmaking itself, on every enemy. Breaks the damage limit.

S401.name: Refused Sentence
S401.desc: The axe falls on the order, not the prisoner. Guardbreak.

S402.name: Ilyr's Wing
S402.desc: The dragon opens a wing over everyone. Barrier; heals 15%.

S403.name: Commuted
S403.desc: A burning cut through armour; the weakest ally is protected.

S404.name: By Agreement
S404.desc: Raven and Ilyr, together by choice. Dragonfire on all; party Haste. Breaks the damage limit.

S405.name: Penumbra
S405.desc: The edge of the eclipse crosses every enemy.

S406.name: Corona
S406.desc: The ring of fire around the dark. 40% Burn.

S407.name: Totality
S407.desc: Full eclipse. Strips a boon; 40% Slow.

S408.name: The Sun Returns
S408.desc: She lets the light back on her own terms. The party regains 30 MP. Breaks the damage limit.

S409.name: Moonfall
S409.desc: Leaps past the clouds and lands like the moon.

S410.name: No One Falls
S410.desc: She goes back for everyone. Revives the fallen at 30%; heals the party.

S411.name: Crescent Harrow
S411.desc: Two diving passes over the whole field.

S412.name: Testimony
S412.desc: The truth, from the highest point. Party Barrier. Breaks the damage limit.

S413.name: Overclock
S413.desc: Pushes every rune past spec. Party Haste; readiness up.

S414.name: Relay Surge
S414.desc: Routes a relay's full load through the enemy.

S415.name: Distributed Grid
S415.desc: Power anyone can maintain. Barrier, Regen, 20 MP.

S416.name: Engine Nobody Owns
S416.desc: His own work, at full output. Breaks the damage limit.

S417.name: Moonlit Volley
S417.desc: Two volleys under the grove's moon.

S418.name: The Grove Remembers
S418.desc: Old roots heal the party and draw out poison, blindness, slow and weakness.

S419.name: Every Path at Once
S419.desc: An arrow down every route. Marks every enemy.

S420.name: Guardian's Last Arrow
S420.desc: The one she kept for the grove. Breaks the damage limit.

S421.name: Blood Memory
S421.desc: His blood remembers every wound healed. Heals the party.

S422.name: Foresight
S422.desc: He tells you what comes next, and lets you choose. Barrier, evasion; reveals intents.

S423.name: Dragon's Dawn
S423.desc: Revives the fallen at 50% and heals everyone.

S424.name: Unwritten Future
S424.desc: No vision holds. Revives and fully restores the party; light on every enemy. Breaks the damage limit.

S425.name: Red Ledger
S425.desc: Every name he bound, cut into the blade. 60% Burn.

S426.name: Broken Rank
S426.desc: He steps out of line twice through the whole enemy line.

S427.name: Unbinding
S427.desc: Cuts every seal and boon off the enemy.

S428.name: Record Burned
S428.desc: One act to cancel the rest. Ignores half of defense. Breaks the damage limit.

S429.name: Cutpurse Flurry
S429.desc: Three quick cuts and a lighter purse.

S430.name: Nine Lives
S430.desc: Everyone gets one of his spare lives. Survives a fatal blow once.

S431.name: Paperwork Death
S431.desc: The records now say it died. 80% Doom; Weaken; Guardbreak.

S432.name: Royal Pardon
S432.desc: The Cat Kingdom's highest mercy. Steals; party Haste. Breaks the damage limit.

S433.name: Foxfire Procession
S433.desc: A wedding of fox lights walks through the enemy.

S434.name: Thousand Masks
S434.desc: Which one is real? The party dodges; 60% Blind on enemies.

S435.name: Court Unmasked
S435.desc: She tears the masks off everyone, and the lies burn.

S436.name: Empress Unveiled
S436.desc: The court sees her as she is. Party Haste. Breaks the damage limit.

S437.name: Last Order
S437.desc: The last command the host gave, carried out well.

S438.name: Host Formation
S438.desc: The party stands in the host's old ranks. Barrier; survives a fatal blow once.

S439.name: Seraph's Descent
S439.desc: He falls on the field like judgment.

S440.name: Judged by Sight
S440.desc: He judges what he sees. Heals the party. Breaks the damage limit.

S441.name: Soul Ferry
S441.desc: Takes a soul's worth and gives half back to her.

S442.name: Ledger Torn
S442.desc: She rips up the abyss's accounts. Weaken, 70% Slow; she gains Focus.

S443.name: Carried Out Alive
S443.desc: She brings everyone back up. Revives at 40%; heals the party.

S444.name: Abyss Unbargained
S444.desc: Pays in her own blood, owes nothing after. Breaks the damage limit.

S445.name: Quarantine Lifted
S445.desc: Cures every ailment on the party and heals.

S447.name: The Cure, Given Away
S447.desc: The recipe, free to all. Heals; Regen; Barrier.

S448.name: Pestilence Unmade
S448.desc: The sickness he was sent to spread, turned on its senders. Breaks the damage limit.

S449.name: Rime Edict
S449.desc: A decree of the old north. 30% Slow.

S450.name: Court Dismissed
S450.desc: He lets his courtiers go, and they guard you on the way out.

S451.name: Absolute Winter
S451.desc: The cold that froze an empire. 60% Slow.

S452.name: Abdication
S452.desc: He sets down the crown, and the winter with it. Breaks the damage limit.

S453.name: Graveyard March
S453.desc: Every soldier he buried marches behind the stroke.

S454.name: The Crown Answers
S454.desc: He answers for the crown, loudly. Weaken and Guardbreak.

S455.name: Kingsfall
S455.desc: How he fell, taught the hard way.

S456.name: Break the Last Crown
S456.desc: What he came back for. Breaks the damage limit.

S457.name: Ossuary Rain
S457.desc: The crypt's bones come down twice.

S458.name: Borrowed Breath
S458.desc: Takes the breath from one enemy and keeps it.

S459.name: Let Them Rest
S459.desc: Nobody here needs him to raise them. Revives at 35%; cures Doom and Poison.

S460.name: Crypts Shut
S460.desc: Every gate closed, the enemy inside. 30% Doom. Breaks the damage limit.

S462.name: Tactical Link
S462.desc: Links the party to his targeting. Haste and Focus.

S463.name: Orbital Correction
S463.desc: Something old in orbit still answers his code.

S464.name: Mission of My Own
S464.desc: Orders he wrote himself. Party readiness up. Breaks the damage limit.

S465.name: High Beam
S465.desc: Full lights in the eyes. 60% Blind.

S466.name: Convoy
S466.desc: Everyone rides in his slipstream. Haste; readiness up.

S467.name: Dead Man's Curve
S467.desc: The bend nobody took at speed, taken.

S468.name: The Road That Was
S468.desc: He rides the whole old highway through them. Breaks the damage limit.

S312.name: Doom Chant
S312.desc: Doom on one enemy (bosses are immune).

S314.name: Chapel Tide
S314.desc: Water on every enemy; may slow.

S318.name: Hollow Roar
S318.desc: Heavy shadow on one enemy; may Doom.

S323.name: Caldera Heart
S323.desc: An ancient dragon's signature, in a smaller throat. Breaks the damage limit.

S324.name: Unmake
S324.desc: What the Unmade Crown did to you. Breaks the damage limit.

S201.name: Capture
S201.desc: Captures a weakened enemy (half HP or less; not bosses). Sometimes it morphs into a rare item.

GN22.desc: It shows you what things are made of. Shows weaknesses. Set: Assembler.

AN14.name: Datum Core
AN14.desc: A builder's memory, still reading. MP +2 per action. Teaches Libra. Set: Assembler.

WN16.name: Ossuan's Bridge-Staff
WN16.desc: A span of the bone bridges, carried. Healing +10%. Set: Sepulchre.

GN23.name: Sepulchre Veil
GN23.desc: Mother Sepulchre's veil for the living. Set: Sepulchre.

AN15.name: Debt-Warden's Ledger
AN15.desc: Every debt the dead are owed. Max MP +8%. Teaches Soul Drain. Set: Sepulchre.

GN24.name: Mourning Crown
GN24.desc: Worn by a court too long in mourning. Set: Sepulchre.

WN17.name: Kingsgrave
WN17.desc: The first crowned king's sword. It chose him. Less damage below 40% HP. Teaches Kingsbane. Set: First Crown.

GN25.name: Barrow-King's Plate
GN25.desc: Plate with a crown worked into the gorget. Set: First Crown.

GN26.name: Circlet of the First
GN26.desc: A tin circlet, older than the Crown. Set: First Crown.

AN16.name: Cindermaw Heartscale
AN16.desc: Scale from over the Surface Wyrm's heart. Resists fire. Teaches Hellfire Ring. Set: Ancient Wyrm.

GN27.name: Thalassar's Crown
GN27.desc: Coral grown round a sea-wyrm's horn. Resists water. Teaches Frozen Judgment. Set: Ancient Wyrm.

AN17.name: Vael's Pinion
AN17.desc: A flight feather that never touched ground. Readiness +8%. Teaches Plasma Combo. Set: Ancient Wyrm.

GN28.name: Ossathrax Bone-Shield
GN28.desc: The Deep Wyrm's shoulder-blade. Resists earth. Teaches Death Nova. Set: Ancient Wyrm.

AN18.name: The Ledger
AN18.desc: Everything the Crown took. Shows weaknesses; magic +8%. Set: Hollow Heart.

AN19.name: The Tally
AN19.desc: Everything it gave back. Healing +12%. Set: Hollow Heart.

GN29.name: The Verdict
GN29.desc: What the two sums mean. Less damage below 40% HP. Set: Hollow Heart.

AN41.name: Breathing Shell
AN41.desc: It breathes with the tide, and so do you. MP +3 per action.

GN42.name: Oathwarden's Helm
GN42.desc: It kept the district's oath long after the district forgot it. Immune to doom, silence.

WN41.name: Customs Seal
WN41.desc: The Tithe's customs seal, sharpened. Every pocket it touches is declared. Accuracy +8.

AN40.name: The Right Bell
AN40.desc: It rings once, correctly, and then keeps quiet. Max HP +12%; immune to doom, stun.

GN40.name: Carillon Mantle
GN40.desc: Woven from bell-rope. It hums when magic passes through it. Magic +8%.

GN41.name: Nave-Warden Plate
GN41.desc: Armour of the drowned cathedral's last guard. Resists shadow, water.

WN40.name: Veyr's Clapper
WN40.desc: The iron tongue of a lesser bell. The Golem swings it like a thought. Storm attacks.

WN18.name: Wurm-Gut Blade
WN18.desc: Recovered from the Forge-Wurm's gut. Branna wants it back. Fire attacks.

WN19.name: Index Stylus
WN19.desc: It writes in a hand nobody reads now. Magic +10%. Teaches System Scan.

WN20.name: Sorrow's Gate-Key
WN20.desc: A key that locks the dead in, or the living out. Immune to doom. Teaches Grave Chill.

WN21.name: Prime Directive
WN21.desc: CURATOR's last order, given edge. Readiness +10%; magic +10%. Teaches Overdrive Mode.

AN20.name: Veil of the Unveiled
AN20.desc: She does not need it any more. Immune to doom, silence, sleep; max HP +10%. Teaches Legion of Bone.

WN22.name: Unbeaten
WN22.desc: Varro's sword. It never learned to lose. Counterattacks; less damage below 40% HP. Teaches Celestial Rush.

AN21.name: Choir's Last Note
AN21.desc: The note the Pale Choir silenced. Concord +2; healing +15%. Teaches Borrowed Dawn.

AN22.name: Circlet of the Unmade
AN22.desc: What the Ashen Crown would have been. Nobody should wear it. Someone will. Max HP +20%; max MP +20%; readiness +10%.

AN23.name: Hunter's Codex
AN23.desc: Every creature you have met, and how it dies. Shows weaknesses; accuracy +15; physical damage -8%. Teaches Libra.

MT01.name: Slag Iron
MT01.desc: Iron pulled from the slag heaps. Brittle until it is folded.

MT02.name: Geode Shard
MT02.desc: A crystal from the Geode Wood. It rings when struck.

MT03.name: Salt Crystal
MT03.desc: Pale Basin salt, hard as glass. It keeps things.

MT04.name: Rime Quartz
MT04.desc: Quartz that never warms. Hoarfrost smiths quench blades in it.

MT05.name: Emberstone
MT05.desc: A stone that holds heat for a year. Delvers carry it for luck.

MT06.name: Grave Silver
MT06.desc: Silver mined by the dead. It does not tarnish.

MT07.name: Coral Branch
MT07.desc: Red coral from the Ember Sea reefs. Tough, and light.

MT08.name: Skysteel Shard
MT08.desc: A splinter of the fallen host's steel. It weighs almost nothing.

MT10.name: Millreed
MT10.desc: A pond reed. Millers bind cuts with it.

MT11.name: Fen Nettle
MT11.desc: Mirewold nettle. It stings, then it cleans.

MT12.name: Lilac Bloom
MT12.desc: A mineral lilac from the Seep. It calms the blood.

MT13.name: Maple Resin
MT13.desc: Red resin from the Vermilion maples. Lacquer and salve.

MT14.name: Glowcap
MT14.desc: A cave mushroom that lights the Fungal Terraces.

MT15.name: Frostmoss
MT15.desc: Moss that grows under ice. It slows a fever.

MT16.name: Sunless Bloom
MT16.desc: A builder garden flower that never saw the sun.

MT17.name: Grave Lily
MT17.desc: It grows on the honoured dead. The mourners let it.

MT18.name: Cliff Thyme
MT18.desc: Skyspine thyme. Shepherds chew it against the wind.

MT20.name: Crown Scrap
MT20.desc: Stamped Crown iron. The Ministry says it is still theirs.

MT21.name: Hull Iron
MT21.desc: Riveted plate from a wreck. Salt has tempered it.

MT22.name: Sea-Glass
MT22.desc: Glass the sea has worn smooth. Bellharbor lensmakers pay well.

MT23.name: Relay Wire
MT23.desc: Builder wire. It still carries a little current.

MT24.name: Builder Alloy
MT24.desc: A metal nobody alive can make. It remembers its shape.

MT25.name: Lantern Glass
MT25.desc: Glass from a keeper's lamp, blown thick against the fault winds.

MT30.name: Rough Hide
MT30.desc: A beast's hide. Good for straps and not much else.

MT31.name: Sharp Fang
MT31.desc: A hunter's tooth. It still wants to bite.

MT32.name: Hard Chitin
MT32.desc: Shell plate. It turns a blade if it is layered.

MT33.name: Swift Feather
MT33.desc: A flight feather. Fletchers and charm-makers want it.

MT34.name: Ember Gland
MT34.desc: It burns in the hand. Bombs and fire charms.

MT35.name: Frost Gland
MT35.desc: Cold enough to hurt. Handle with gloves.

MT37.name: Static Coil
MT37.desc: A crackling organ. Storm-touched things grow them.

MT38.name: Grave Dust
MT38.desc: What the dead leave behind. Priests and poisoners both buy it.

MT39.name: Wisp Essence
MT39.desc: A little of a spirit's light, caught in glass.

MT40.name: Gear Core
MT40.desc: The heart of a builder machine. It ticks.

MT41.name: Dragon Scale
MT41.desc: A scale from a dragon's kin. It remembers fire.

MT43.name: Brute Sinew
MT43.desc: Tendon from something large. Bowyers prize it.

MT44.name: Leech Ichor
MT44.desc: Thin, red, and not all of it the leech's own.

MT45.name: Seraph Down
MT45.desc: Soft feathers from the fallen host. They glow faintly.

MT46.name: Wyrm Heart
MT46.desc: The heart of an ancient dragon. It is still warm.

IC01.name: Millreed Poultice
IC01.desc: Restores 400 HP to one ally and cures Poison.

IC02.name: Slag Bomb
IC02.desc: Deals fire damage to one enemy.

IC04.name: Fen Antidote
IC04.desc: Cures Poison, Burn, Bleed, Blind, Sleep and Silence on the whole party.

IC06.name: Frost Flask
IC06.desc: Deals ice damage to one enemy and may Slow it.

IC07.name: Maple Salve
IC07.desc: Grants Regen to the whole party.

IC09.name: Grave Lily Tincture
IC09.desc: Revives one ally with half HP.

IC10.name: Storm Canister
IC10.desc: Deals storm damage to one enemy.

IC11.name: Hearth Draught
IC11.desc: Restores 1500 HP to the whole party.

IC12.name: Waking Salts
IC12.desc: Cures Sleep, Blind and Silence on one ally.

ZW01.name: Wayfarer's Sigil
ZW01.desc: Opens the waystone roads from anywhere outside battle and dungeons. Consumed on travel.

A202.name: Champion's Laurel
A202.desc: Breaks the damage limit; counters physical hits.

A203.name: Crown of Nothing
A203.desc: Breaks the damage limit; +10% magic power.

Y01.name: Fish Fillet
Y01.desc: Fresh-caught and grilled. Restores 180 HP to one ally.

Y02.name: Silver Roe
Y02.desc: Salted roe. Restores 30 MP to one ally.

Y03.name: Fish Scales
Y03.desc: Hard, bright scales. Smiths and crafters pay for them.

Y04.name: Shark Tooth
Y04.desc: A tooth as long as a finger. Worth a great deal to a crafter.

Y05.name: Pearl
Y05.desc: A pearl from the deep water. Sells for a fortune.

Y07.name: Bottled Message
Y07.desc: A letter nobody answered. The ink has run.

Y08.name: Waylamp
Y08.desc: A shuttered lamp lit from a save lamp's flame. Opens the save ledger anywhere outside battle and boss rooms.

RF01.name: Farmhouse Stew
RF01.desc: Milk, potato and onion, boiled until it gives up. Restores 600 HP to the whole party.

RF02.name: Truffle Tart
RF02.desc: Too rich for a farmhand. Restores 40 MP to the whole party.

RF03.name: Pumpkin Loaf
RF03.desc: Dense, sweet, keeps a week. Restores 500 HP to one ally and cures Poison.

RF04.name: Pepper Broth
RF04.desc: It hurts going down and keeps you up. Grants Regen to the whole party.

RF05.name: Grape Cordial
RF05.desc: The fox court's cordial, thick as syrup. Restores 90 MP to one ally.

RF06.name: Rind Cheese
RF06.desc: Pressed milk, rind and all. Restores 320 HP to one ally.

RK01.name: Fresh Milk
RK01.desc: Warm from the pail. Restores 150 HP to one ally.

RK02.name: Dove Egg
RK02.desc: Small and pale. Restores 90 HP to one ally.

RK03.name: Angora Wool
RK03.desc: Combed coney wool, soft as smoke. Weavers and crafters want it.

RK04.name: Black Truffle
RK04.desc: Rooted up by a pig and fought over by cooks. Sells for a great deal.

RS01.name: Wheat Seed
RS01.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 1 day; yields 3.

RS02.name: Carrot Seed
RS02.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 1 day; yields 3.

RS03.name: Potato Seed
RS03.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 2 days; yields 4.

RS04.name: Pumpkin Seed
RS04.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 3 days; yields 2.

RS05.name: Onion Seed
RS05.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 1 day; yields 3.

RS06.name: Beetroot Seed
RS06.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 2 days; yields 3.

RS07.name: Leek Seed
RS07.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 2 days; yields 3.

RS08.name: Radish Seed
RS08.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 1 day; yields 3.

RS09.name: Tomato Seed
RS09.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 2 days; yields 4.

RS10.name: Cauliflower Seed
RS10.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 2 days; yields 2.

RS11.name: Fen Berry Seed
RS11.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 2 days; yields 4.

RS12.name: Ember Pepper Seed
RS12.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 3 days; yields 3.

RS13.name: Eggplant Seed
RS13.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 2 days; yields 3.

RS14.name: Court Grapes Seed
RS14.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 3 days; yields 3.

RS15.name: Bamboo Shoot Seed
RS15.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 3 days; yields 3.

RS16.name: Corn Seed
RS16.desc: Seed for a ranch plot. Ripe in 2 days; yields 3.

RV01.name: Wheat
RV01.desc: A sheaf of wheat. Millers and bakers pay for it.

RV02.name: Carrot
RV02.desc: Raw and crunchy. Restores 60 HP and cures Blind.

RV03.name: Potato
RV03.desc: Fist-sized and dirty. Better in a stew.

RV04.name: Pumpkin
RV04.desc: Heavy as a child. Bakers want it for loaves.

RV05.name: Onion
RV05.desc: It makes the cook weep, and the stew worth eating.

RV06.name: Beetroot
RV06.desc: Earthy and red. Restores 80 HP to one ally.

RV07.name: Leek
RV07.desc: Long and pale. Broth needs it.

RV08.name: Radish
RV08.desc: Sharp enough to clear the head. Cures Poison.

RV09.name: Tomato
RV09.desc: Ripe and split. Restores 100 HP to one ally.

RV10.name: Cauliflower
RV10.desc: A tight white head. The salt cooks pickle it.

RV11.name: Fen Berry
RV11.desc: Bitter fen berries. Restores 15 MP to one ally.

RV12.name: Ember Pepper
RV12.desc: Burns the tongue awake. Restores 40 HP and cures Sleep.

RV13.name: Eggplant
RV13.desc: Purple and glossy. Basin cooks roast it on stones.

RV14.name: Court Grapes
RV14.desc: The fox court's table grapes. Restores 25 MP to one ally.

RV15.name: Bamboo Shoot
RV15.desc: A tender shoot. The fox court eats it in spring.

RV16.name: Corn
RV16.desc: A full ear. Fodder, flour or supper.

RA01.name: Shepherd's Muffler
RA01.desc: A muffler of angora wool. Wards off Sleep and Slow.

poison.name: Poison
poison.desc: Lose 4% max HP after acting; can KO; ends after battle.

burn.name: Burn
burn.desc: Lose 3% max HP after acting and physical damage dealt x0.90.

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.desc: Lose 5% max HP after a physical action; nonphysical action still consumes one duration.

silence.name: Silence
silence.desc: Blocks spells and summons, not Item, Attack, Defend or physical skills.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.desc: Skip one readiness opportunity; direct damage wakes immediately.

stun.name: Stun
stun.desc: Skip one readiness opportunity; reapplication cannot extend until target has acted.

slow.name: Slow
slow.desc: ATB fill x0.75; bosses x0.90; mutually exclusive with Haste.

haste.name: Haste
haste.desc: ATB fill x1.25; mutually exclusive with Slow.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.desc: Direct damage received x0.75; not poison or HP transfers.

regen.name: Regen
regen.desc: Restore 5% max HP after acting; cannot revive.

mark.name: Mark
mark.desc: Direct physical damage received x1.10 and eligible skill synergies.

blind.name: Blind
blind.desc: Physical hit chance reduced by 25 percentage points, minimum 50%.

doom.name: Doom
doom.desc: Visible countdown; KO on expiry; boss immunity; cleansable and never random on the first tutorial boss.

weaken.name: Weaken
weaken.desc: ATK and MAG x0.85; temporary derived stats only.

focus.name: Focus
focus.desc: Accuracy +10 percentage points and critical chance +5 points, within caps.

E001.name: Rail Rat
E001.behavior: Bites the lowest current-HP front-row member; its tell is a short crouch.

E002.name: Clamp Beetle
E002.behavior: Alternates a normal hit and one-action shell; attack another target during shell.

E003.name: Quarry Wisp
E003.behavior: Charges a small fire bolt; interruptible by any direct hit during its announced charge.

E004.name: Ministry Hound

ops.text: The hound fixes on its prey.

E004.behavior: Marks one target before a lunge; cannot mark a fallen ally.

E005.name: Canal Slime
E005.behavior: Splits once below 50% HP; child has no further split and no extra rare loot.

E006.name: Seal Drone
E006.behavior: Applies short Silence, then a weak strike; cannot Silence the whole party at once.

E007.name: Ledger Moth
E007.behavior: Steals at most 10 temporary battle gold; all stolen gold returns on victory.

E008.name: Patrol Shell
E008.behavior: Guards the nearest ally for one action, then exposes its core.

E009.name: Briar Wolf
E009.behavior: Coordinated bite gains 10% if another wolf lives; capped at two wolves.

E010.name: Root Mite
E010.behavior: Applies Poison only after a one-action sap tell.

E011.name: Pollen Bell
E011.behavior: Sleep pollen affects one target and cannot be reapplied before that target acts.

E012.name: Bog Lantern

ops.text: The lantern's glow drifts toward its next target.

E012.behavior: Alternates water damage and a harmless lure animation that reveals its next target.

E013.name: Rivet Imp
E013.behavior: Throws a ranged rivet, then reloads for one opportunity.

E014.name: Boiler Crab
E014.behavior: Pressure grows for two actions, then a small area burst; cold reduces pressure.

E015.name: Soot Sprite
E015.behavior: Uses Blind, then weak shadow damage; healing items remain usable.

E016.name: Furnace Hand

raise.name: Fist Raised
raise.tell: The fist rises - Defend halves the blow

E016.behavior: Raises a fist before a strong single-target strike; defense halves it.

E017.name: Tide Page
E017.behavior: Copies the element of the last incoming spell at reduced power.

E018.name: Salt Leech
E018.behavior: Drain heals only actual HP damage dealt.

E019.name: Bell Diver
E019.behavior: Alternates melee and a water spell; explicit undead tag permits hostile healing.

E020.name: Archive Eye

ops.text: The eye studies the strongest mind.

E020.behavior: Reveals and then targets the highest-MP ally; never drains more than 15 MP.

E021.name: Chain Kite
E021.behavior: Two light hits are one source action for counter limits.

E022.name: Gust Viper
E022.behavior: Dodges melee slightly; ranged and magical counters remain reliable.

E023.name: Ballast Golem

windup.name: Ballast Slam
windup.tell: The golem winds up a slow slam

E023.behavior: High DEF, low RES; attacks slowly with a visible windup.

E024.name: Sky Tick
E024.behavior: Applies Slow to one target, then rests.

E025.name: Ivory Sentinel

ops.text: Its sigil turns to face magic.

E025.behavior: Alternates physical guard and magic guard, visibly changing sigils.

E026.name: Seal Leech
E026.behavior: Removes one party buff; never steals permanent learned abilities.

E027.name: Frost Runner
E027.behavior: Fast ice bite, low HP; no unavoidable opening burst.

E028.name: Binding Hound
E028.behavior: Brief one-target Stun; respects hard-control recovery protection.

E029.name: Memory Shard
E029.behavior: Echoes a normal Attack once, using its own stats.

E030.name: Pale Singer
E030.behavior: Heals one enemy at 50% power before repeating a weak light spell.

E031.name: Glass Widow
E031.behavior: Telegraphed Bleed; cleanse or switch to magic/Item to reduce its cost.

E032.name: Absent Knight
E032.behavior: Strong front-row melee; low accuracy and explicit undead affinity.

E033.name: Crown Relay
E033.behavior: Empowers one ally by 10%; duplicate relays do not stack buffs.

E034.name: Ash Lancer

charge.name: Row Lance
charge.tell: Lance lowered at the front row

E034.behavior: Charges for one full opportunity, then strikes a marked row.

E035.name: Threshold Wisp
E035.behavior: Fire spell followed by a self-exposing recovery period.

E036.name: Edict Shell
E036.behavior: Weaken seal on one target, then slow physical strike.

E037.name: Broken Seraph
E037.behavior: Warns before light area damage; physically fragile.

E038.name: Cinder Automaton
E038.behavior: Rotates defense and pressure without invulnerable phases.

E039.name: Hollow Choirling
E039.behavior: Schedules a two-action Doom warning; player has cleanse and damage options.

E040.name: Crown Remnant
E040.behavior: Cycles attack families to teach the final boss; no unique stolen keys.

E041.name: Mill Rat Swarm
E041.behavior: Three quick nibbles on random targets.
E041.lore: Fat on Crown grain. Where they nest, the tithe was never paid.

E042.name: Toll Hound
E042.behavior: Marks, then lunges; weak to fire.
E042.lore: Bred at Gallowgate to sniff out undeclared cargo. Some of the cargo was children.

E043.name: Orchard Wisp
E043.behavior: Blinding flare, then a soft light bolt.
E043.lore: The pickers say the wisps are last year's harvest workers, still counting apples.

E044.name: Drowned Oathknight
E044.lore: Knights who swore to hold the chapel against the flood. They kept the oath.

E045.name: Chapel Mimic
E045.behavior: Snaps shut for massive damage, then rests.
E045.lore: The offering chest learned to feed itself.

E046.name: Barrow Wight
E046.lore: Buried with a crown of tin. It remembers being told it was gold.

E047.name: Slag Crawler
E047.lore: Ate the slag heaps behind Kettle Row and kept growing.

E048.name: Pipe Viper
E048.lore: Nests in warm pipe. The fitters leave it milk and a spanner.

E049.name: Scrap Bandit
E049.behavior: Steals, then flees at low HP.
E049.lore: Lost a shift, then a house, then a name. Took up the only trade that was hiring.

E050.name: Cinder Imp
E050.lore: It laughs in the voice of whichever worker it burned last.

E051.name: Magma Golem
E051.behavior: Slow molten punch; weak to water.
E051.lore: Poured into a mould shaped like a man, and it never cooled.

E052.name: Dam Leech
E052.lore: The dam wept for years. These are what it wept.

E053.name: Wreck Crab
E053.behavior: Shell up, then a pincer crush.
E053.lore: Its shell is a customs lockbox. Nobody has the key.

E054.name: Gull Harpy
E054.behavior: Swoops twice at the back row.
E054.lore: Steals shining things from the drowned. Sometimes rings; sometimes teeth.

E055.name: Brine Naga
E055.behavior: Tidal wave on a row; slow gaze.
E055.lore: Keeper of the sea-caves. She lets the tide decide who leaves.

E056.name: Siren of the Stair
E056.behavior: Sleep song, then a drowning strike.
E056.lore: Sings the names of sailors in their mothers' voices.

E057.name: Reef Shark
E057.lore: Follows the ferry lanes. It has learned what a capsized hull means.

E058.name: Isle Toad
E058.lore: Its croak rings like a bell. Smugglers use it to time the watch.

E059.name: Cliff Griffon
E059.lore: The aerie guard once rode them. Now they ride the wind alone.

E060.name: Roc Chick
E060.lore: Big as a cart and still hungry.

E061.name: Frost Yeti
E061.behavior: Ice slam on the front row.
E061.lore: Shepherds leave it one ewe each winter. It leaves the rest.

E062.name: Wind Sprite
E062.behavior: Gust knocks targets back a row.
E062.lore: Born in the ninefold shrine's cloths, it chases prayers down the cliff.

E063.name: Salt Wraith
E063.behavior: Drains MP; fades in and out.
E063.lore: The salt keeps what the water forgets. It kept her.

E064.name: Memory Moth
E064.lore: Drinks the lake's drowned memories and leaves the drinkers empty.

E065.name: Mere Maw
E065.lore: The lake's mouth. Sorrowmere's villagers called it Grandmother.

E066.name: Crystal Stalker
E066.lore: Hunts by reflection. Stand still and it sees a hundred of you.

E067.name: Blight Grub
E067.lore: Fattened on the quarantine pits. The fen folk say it hums the plague bell's note.

E068.name: Fen Lurker
E068.behavior: Drags a target into the water (stun).
E068.lore: It waits under the causeway boards for the quarantine carts.

E069.name: Gibbet Crow
E069.lore: They learned the gallows bell means supper.

E070.name: Quarantine Warden
E070.lore: An empty suit of plague armour still walking its post. The order was never lifted.

E071.name: Leech Acolyte
E071.lore: The Order sold the cure by the pint. Its acolytes kept the change.

E072.name: Bog Hag
E072.lore: She sold charms against the plague. Some of them worked, which was worse.

E073.name: Rotting Reaper
E073.behavior: Scythe sweep; doom on a crit.
E073.lore: Cathedral's gravedigger. It stopped waiting for the bodies to arrive.

E074.name: Lantern Tanuki
E074.lore: Brings its own lantern to a fight. Takes yours when it leaves.

E075.name: Masked Ronin
E075.behavior: Counter stance, then a quick draw.
E075.lore: Served the fox court before the exile. Now he serves whoever pays in rice.

E076.name: Foxfire Kit
E076.behavior: Illusory fire on a random target.
E076.lore: The fox wedding's lanterns, walking home without the bride.

E077.name: Gate Oni
E077.behavior: Club smash; enrages below half HP.
E077.lore: Each of the thousand gates has a keeper. This one has forgotten which gate.

E078.name: Paper Spirit
E078.lore: A petition folded into a man. It keeps asking the court to read it.

E079.name: Moss Monk
E079.lore: Sat in meditation so long the forest took him for a stone.

E080.name: Maple Serpent
E080.lore: Red as autumn and patient as winter.

E081.name: Frost Wolf
E081.lore: The tundra's last hunters. They follow the Lich King's cold like a shepherd.

E082.name: Rime Bear
E082.lore: Sleeps a hundred days and wakes angry about all of them.

E083.name: Ice Maiden
E083.lore: The spire's first climber. She reached the top.

E084.name: Frozen Legionary
E084.lore: Part of a court that died of cold. Still in rank, still waiting for orders.

E085.name: Glacier Drake
E085.lore: Wings of cracked ice. It sheds a small glacier every spring.

E086.name: Hoarfrost Wisp
E086.lore: The breath of someone who died on the Ice Road.

E087.name: Choir Seraph
E087.behavior: Heals, then a hymn of light.
E087.lore: Sings the last order the host received. It no longer knows what it means.

E088.name: Fallen Cherub
E088.lore: Too small to fall far. It fell anyway.

E089.name: Host Sentinel
E089.lore: Guards a throne that stopped answering thirty years ago.

E090.name: Sky Wyvern
E090.lore: Nests in the host's broken organ pipes. Its cry is a flat note.

E091.name: Geode Scuttler
E091.lore: Grows jewels on its back. The delvers farm them, carefully.

E092.name: Delver Deserter
E092.lore: Ran from King Horrach's debt. Now he owes the dark instead.

E093.name: Magma Salamander
E093.lore: Swims the lava rivers. The magma ferrymen tip it in copper.

E094.name: Bone Drakeling
E094.lore: Hatched from an egg left in a dragon's ossuary. It thinks the bones are its mother.

E095.name: Crown Digger
E095.lore: The Crown's mining suits, still digging after their crews ran.

E096.name: Fungal Shambler
E096.lore: The fungal terraces grow their own farmhands.

E097.name: Ember Bat
E097.lore: Roosts in the heat above the magma and drops like sparks.

E098.name: Scale Wraith
E098.lore: A dragonborn who died unbound. Its fragment never found a home.

E099.name: Keeper Drone
E099.lore: Still maintains a city nobody lives in.

E100.name: Sawblade Skitterer
E100.lore: A floor cleaner that found out what else it could cut.

E101.name: Volt Turret
E101.lore: Its target list was last updated when the builders were alive.

E102.name: Assembly Walker
E102.lore: Built to carry the builders. It still waits at the stops.

E103.name: Junk Golem
E103.lore: Assembled itself from the parts of its friends.

E104.name: Magnet Maw
E104.lore: Eats anything iron. It has a taste for Crown steel.

E105.name: Datum Ghost
E105.lore: A builder's record that kept running after its person stopped.

E106.name: Chrome Hound
E106.lore: The Lattice's watchdogs. CURATOR taught them what an intruder smells like.

E107.name: Mourning Shade
E107.lore: Carries its own grave-candle. It will not say whose.

E108.name: Bone Knight
E108.lore: Mother Sepulchre pays her soldiers in the dead. They are always paid.

E109.name: Grave Lich
E109.behavior: Doom on one target; dark wave.
E109.lore: A priest who bargained for one more year. Then one more.

E110.name: Ferryman's Hound
E110.lore: Guards Styx Landing. It lets the living in. It is the leaving it minds.

E111.name: Abyss Valkyrie
E111.lore: Inferna's former sisters. They still collect.

E112.name: Coffin Mimic
E112.lore: In Cenotaph even the coffins are hungry.

E113.name: Weeping Miner
E113.lore: Still digging. The seam they want is their own names.

E114.name: Abyss Angler
E114.lore: Its lantern is a drowned lighthouse keeper's lamp.

E115.name: Drowned Citizen
E115.lore: Old Bellharbor never evacuated its lower streets.

E116.name: Reef Titan
E116.lore: The reef grew on its back while it slept. It woke up an island.

E117.name: Kraken Spawn
E117.lore: Young, which is to say only the size of a ferry.

E118.name: Night Mare
E118.lore: Runs only on moonless roads. Travellers who see it never finish the journey the same.

E119.name: Gilded Tanuki
E119.lore: Its coins turn to leaves at dawn. Spend them fast.

E120.name: Wandering Armor
E120.lore: A suit of the old Crown's armour that forgot which war it was in.

B01.name: Extractor Warden

clamp.name: Pressure Clamp
clamp.tell: The digging arm hovers; the red gauge fills

vent.name: Vent and Sweep
vent.tell: Vents hiss open for a sweep

phases.enter: The Warden's pressure gauge redlines.
Steam bursts from every seam - the Warden vents.

B01.tell: A digging arm pauses over one target while a red pressure gauge fills
B01.counterplay: Defend the marked target or use Tessa's storm flask tutorial pickup; attacking the valve also reduces the hit

B02.name: Brass Bailiff

ops.text: A warrant names its next target.
Three warrants flutter; one seal glows.

restrain.name: Restraint
restrain.tell: The warrant's seal glows - restraint incoming

phases.enter: The Bailiff stamps duplicate warrants - only one seal is live.

B02.tell: A stamped warrant names its next target one action before restraint
B02.counterplay: Cleanse or destroy the paper seal; Guard reduces the follow-up

B03.name: Rootbound Stag

cage.name: Root Cage
cage.tell: Antlers bloom - roots coil toward the back row

phases.enter: Roots split the floor around the back row.
The antlers shed a cloud of pollen.

B03.tell: The antlers bloom before a root binds the back row
B03.counterplay: Burn one root or use a weapon attack twice; bind expires even without the ideal counter

B04.name: Foundry Colossus

sweep.name: Boiler Sweep
sweep.tell: All three vents blaze - boiler sweep

phases.enter: Steam screens the Colossus's joints.
Three vents glow along its back.

B04.tell: Three vents light from left to right before the boiler sweep
B04.counterplay: Use ice, ground the charge or defend; pressure resets after the sweep rather than climbing forever

B05.name: Bell-Sworn Custodian

mirror.name: Mirror Bell
mirror.tell: A bell vibrates - it will mirror the last element

phases.enter: One of three bells begins to vibrate.
The Custodian draws breath for a choral wave.

B05.tell: One of three visible bells vibrates before the Custodian mirrors an element
B05.counterplay: Use a different element or physical attacks; a mirrored element resists rather than instantly kills the party

B06.name: Chain Roc

dive.name: Tethered Dive
dive.tell: A shadow marks the front row

phases.enter: The tether strains; a shadow sweeps a row.
The Roc pulls against its chain with free wings.

B06.tell: The tether strains and a shadow marks the row targeted by the dive
B06.counterplay: Defend or use Corren's aerial counter; either row can be made safe

B07.name: Ivory Adjudicator

phases.enter: A judgment mark hangs over the party.
Two sigils rotate, a full action of warning apart.

B07.tell: A visible sigil announces whether the next seal targets a skill or an item
B07.counterplay: Alternate command families or dispel; basic Attack and Defend are never simultaneously locked

B08.name: Pale Choir

echo.name: Echo Command
echo.tell: Masks light - the echo targets the repeated command

phases.enter: Three masks light, naming the command they will echo.
The Choir tries to sing with one voice.

B08.tell: Three masks highlight the next repeated command it will echo
B08.counterplay: Vary actions or defend the repeat; players are not punished for merely opening menus

B09.name: Marshal Voss

barrage.name: Command Barrage
barrage.tell: The baton points at every protector

phases.enter: Voss raises the baton and points at a protector.
'Hold the line,' Voss says, to no one who can refuse.

B09.tell: Voss raises the command baton and points to a protector
B09.counterplay: Change targets, dispel the order or defend; counterattacks have a per-action recursion guard

B10.name: Elian Rook, Threshold Maker

pulse.name: Synchronization Pulse
pulse.tell: Three relay lights announce a pulse

phases.enter: Relay lights climb toward synchronization.
Rook accelerates the pulse; his recovery shows.

B10.tell: Three relay lights announce a full-party synchronization pulse
B10.counterplay: Break either active relay or defend; relay destruction reduces rather than cancels the required story event

B11.name: Ash-Tide Warden

ops.text: The flood marker rises a notch.

surge.name: Surge
surge.tell: The marker reaches the notch - surge coming

phases.enter: The flood marker climbs toward the surge notch.
The Warden's core is exposed.

B11.tell: A flood marker rises one step per action; a clear notch indicates the surge threshold
B11.counterplay: Strike a current valve, defend or use Nera's Snare on the channel add

B12.name: Crown Vessel

named.name: Named Command
named.tell: Voss names a command - vary your actions

rings.name: Pressure Rings
rings.tell: Three rings blaze - Defend through the release

ops.text: The crown vents; its core is visible.

phases.enter: The shell cracks; the coercion network shows through.
The crown overloads - three pressure rings illuminate.

B12.tell: Phase 1: shield tether; phase 2: named command; phase 3: three illuminated pressure rings
B12.counterplay: Phase 1: separate targets. Phase 2: alternate commands and dispel. Phase 3: stagger attacks and defend during the visible release. All counters also have accessible consumable equivalents

B13.name: Lantern Eater

sleep.name: Sleep Lantern
sleep.tell: The dark lantern chooses a sleeper

phases.enter: A lantern gutters; its shadow picks a sleeper.
The long night pulses.

B13.tell: A lantern extinguishes and its shadow selects the next sleeper
B13.counterplay: Relight it with fire or a reusable arena interaction; immunity is not required

B14.name: Heartless Leviathan

tide.name: Returning Tide
tide.tell: Beacons flash - the tide returns to the front row

wreck.name: Wreck Memory
wreck.tell: The bell of the lost ship rings

phases.enter: Wave bands pulse toward one row.
The wreck's last instant repeats.

B14.tell: Wave bands and beacon flashes show the next current direction
B14.counterplay: Ground the charge or defend the marked row; audio and visual timing match

B15.name: Regent's Echo

edict.name: Final Edict
edict.tell: The screen names the edict - Defend or dispel

phases.enter: The command screen duplicates its orders.
FINAL EDICT is printed on the screen.

B15.tell: The old command screen names the action that will be taxed next
B15.counterplay: Choose a different action, dispel or accept a bounded penalty. It never steals unique gear or deletes saves

B16.name: Null Cantor

silence.name: Mute Refrain
silence.tell: A four-beat ring: silence window - Defend

chorus.name: Open Chorus
chorus.tell: The ring opens: response window after this

phases.enter: A four-beat ring marks the canon.
The Cantor opens its chorus.

B16.tell: A visible four-beat ring marks a silence window, then a response window
B16.counterplay: Defend through silence; act through response; Wait mode preserves the same simulation beats

BX01.name: Ser Hallam, the Oath-Drowned

phases.enter: Water pours from Hallam's visor. The chapel floods to the knee.

BX01.tell: Hallam raises his shield before every swing he cannot land
BX01.counterplay: Break the Oath guard with storm, or wait it out and Defend through the tide.
BX01.lore: Knight-commander of the chapel order. He swore to hold the chapel until relieved. Nobody came.

BX02.name: The Slag Colossus

meltdown.name: Meltdown
meltdown.tell: The core whitens and the air shakes

phases.enter: The colossus's crust hardens as it cools.
Its core glows white. The terraces start to run.

BX02.tell: The core brightens before the meltdown
BX02.counterplay: Ice cracks the crust; spread out the burn with cleanses.
BX02.lore: Built from the overflow of a hundred furnaces. It walks the terraces because nobody told the slag to stop.

BX03.name: The Brine Matriarch

phases.enter: The Matriarch calls her brood from the pools.

BX03.tell: The pools drain toward her before the undertow
BX03.counterplay: Keep a waker ready for the hymn; storm stops her healing.
BX03.lore: Mother of the sea-cave broods. The smugglers paid her in drowned men; she kept the receipts.

BX04.name: Aurelle, Roc Queen

dive.name: Stoop
dive.tell: Her shadow crosses the back row

phases.enter: Aurelle takes to the air over the nest.

BX04.tell: Her shadow marks the row she will dive on
BX04.counterplay: Move the back row forward when the shadow crosses it; earth grounds her.
BX04.lore: The last roc queen of the Skyspine. Her eggs are worth a fortune; her mood is not.

BX05.name: The Mere-Mother

phases.enter: A second head surfaces, weeping.
All the heads rise. The mere remembers everything at once.

BX05.tell: The lake climbs the shore before it rises
BX05.counterplay: Light on the weeping head stops the memories; ice early, fire late.
BX05.lore: Each head remembers a different drowned village. Kill one and the lake forgets it.

BX06.name: Abbot Lamprey

phases.enter: Lamprey sheds his robes. The cathedral's leeches answer.

BX06.tell: The censer swings wide before the plague
BX06.counterplay: Fire and light burn him; carry antidotes and cure the party after the censer.
BX06.lore: The plague order's abbot, who sold the cure and kept the disease. He has been feeding for years.

BX07.name: The Nine-Tailed Magistrate

sentence.name: Final Sentence
sentence.tell: The marked one is named aloud

phases.enter: Three more tails ignite. The court is in session.
Every tail burns. The Magistrate reads the sentence.

BX07.tell: The marked one is named aloud
BX07.counterplay: Guard or cover the marked ally before the sentence; water douses the tails.
BX07.lore: Judge of the Fox Court's lower gates. Every tail is a verdict it has never overturned.

BX08.name: The Rimebound Behemoth

phases.enter: Ice closes over the Behemoth's wounds.

BX08.tell: The wind drops to nothing before the whiteout
BX08.counterplay: Fire breaks the rime shell; Defend in the silence before the whiteout.
BX08.lore: Frozen into the spire's heart before the Crown was a crown. The thaw woke it hungry.

BX09.name: The Frosthorn Warden

phases.enter: The Warden calls the court's cold down on the hall.

BX09.counterplay: Keep silence cures; fire, then light when the court comes.
BX09.lore: Guardian of the Lich King's frozen seat. It has not let anyone in for three hundred winters.

BX10.name: The Hollow Seraph

finale.name: Finale
finale.tell: The organ holds a single chord

phases.enter: The Seraph raises its baton. The broken organ answers.
The last movement begins.

BX10.tell: The organ holds one chord before the finale
BX10.counterplay: Silence it to stop the hymn; shadow cuts through; Defend in the chord.
BX10.lore: What is left of the host's choirmaster when the song stops. It still conducts.

BX11.name: The Sluicewife

phases.enter: The dam groans. Water bursts through her.

BX11.counterplay: Storm is strong; Defend through the breach.
BX11.lore: The dam keeper's widow, now the dam. Every crack is a grievance she never filed.

BX12.name: Marrow Tyrant

breath.name: Bone-Dust Breath
breath.tell: It drags in a long breath of dust

phases.enter: The Tyrant cracks a rib of Ilyrath and swallows the marrow.

BX12.tell: It drags in a long breath of dust
BX12.counterplay: Stop its feasting with pressure; storm; cure blind.
BX12.lore: A scavenger dragon that made its nest in Ilyrath's ribs and grew fat on the fault.

BX13.name: The Tessellate Engine

phases.enter: The Engine lays another course of the tower around itself.
DEMOLITION SCHEDULED.

BX13.counterplay: Strike the governor core to slow its schedule; Defend on demolition.
BX13.lore: The builder tower's governor. It rose with the tower and resumed a construction schedule nobody alive remembers.

BX14.name: The Geode Hydra

phases.enter: The hydra splits along its fault lines.

BX14.counterplay: Fire cracks the prism; earth once it splits.
BX14.lore: Crystal grown around a living heart. Every shard it sheds becomes another mouth.

BX15.name: The Wingless Remnant

hollow.name: Hollow Roar
hollow.tell: It turns its empty eyes on one of you

phases.enter: Ilyr stirs in Raven. The Remnant hears him.

BX15.tell: It turns its empty eyes on one of you
BX15.lore: A dragon that lost its fragment and kept living. Ilyr knows its name and will not say it.

BX16.name: Foreman Grisk's Excavator

phases.enter: Grisk: 'Overtime! Nobody leaves till the seam's dry!'

BX16.tell: Grisk lights a fuse before the blast
BX16.counterplay: Break the cab to stop the overtime; storm and water short it out.
BX16.lore: The Crown's deep-dig machine with its foreman welded into the cab. He calls it overtime.

BX17.name: The Forge-Wurm

phases.enter: The wurm sheds a skin of iron.

BX17.tell: Its plates lift before the molt
BX17.counterplay: Ice; keep the weakest ally topped up.
BX17.lore: It eats ore and excretes ingots. The delvers mine it more than the rock.

BX18.name: Assembler Prime

recall.name: Recall All Units
recall.tell: Every machine on the floor turns toward you

phases.enter: The production line starts again.
Assembler Prime recalls every unit on the floor.

BX18.counterplay: Water shorts it; Defend on the recall.
BX18.lore: The factory floor's first automaton. It has built ten thousand soldiers for a war that ended an age ago.

BX19.name: The Index

phases.enter: PENDING DELETION: APPROVED.

BX19.counterplay: Protect the marked ally; shadow blinds the eye.
BX19.lore: The archive's cataloguing eye. It files every visitor under 'pending deletion'.

BX20.name: Kael-00

orders.name: Self-Issued Order
orders.tell: Its lights cycle through every colour

phases.enter: Kael-00: 'Orders received. Correction: orders invented.'

BX20.lore: The prototype Kael-09 was copied from. It never received its standing orders and has been waiting.

BX21.name: Ossuan, Keeper of the Bridges

collapse.name: Collapse the Span
collapse.tell: The bridge cracks under your feet

phases.enter: Ossuan pulls a bone from the bridge. The span sags.

BX21.tell: The bridge cracks under your feet
BX21.lore: It collects a toll of one bone per crossing. The bridges are the tolls.

BX22.name: Mother Sepulchre

phases.enter: Mother Sepulchre: 'Hush now. You're home.'
Her veil lifts an inch.

BX22.counterplay: Light; cure doom and sleep; Defend when she opens her arms.
BX22.lore: Queen of the Hollow Throne and Velkhar's old rival. She does not raise the dead. She adopts them.

BX23.name: The Warden of Debts

phases.enter: The Warden opens the ledger to Inferna's page.

BX23.counterplay: Ice and water; cleanse the ledger's curse.
BX23.lore: Keeper of the Abyss Gate's ledger. It remembers what Inferna owes, to the soul.

BX24.name: The First Crown

ash.name: The First Ash
ash.tell: Ash falls like snow in the tomb

phases.enter: The First Crown remembers being worn.
The crown ignites. It was ash before it was gold.

BX24.tell: Ash falls like snow before the first ash
BX24.counterplay: Light; later water; keep silence cures ready.
BX24.lore: The first wearer of the Ashen Crown, entombed with it. The crown was copied; the king was not.

BX25.name: The Mourning Court

procession.name: Funeral Procession
procession.tell: Bells toll once for each of you

phases.enter: The courtiers step out of the body one by one.

BX25.tell: Bells toll once for each of you
BX25.lore: The Lich King's under-court, a single body of every courtier who grieved too long.

BX26.name: Gatewarden Sorrow

gate.name: Shut the Gate
gate.tell: The crypt-gate grinds closed behind you

phases.enter: Sorrow: 'He taught you too? Then he taught you wrong.'

BX26.lore: Velkhar's first student, who stayed behind to hold the gate when he left. She is still angry.

BX27.name: The Bell That Rang Wrong

knell.name: Knell of Veyr
knell.tell: Every bell in the drowned city answers at once

phases.enter: The bell swings on no rope. The water shivers.
It remembers the note it rang at the fault.

BX27.tell: Every bell in the city answers before the knell
BX27.counterplay: Earth muffles it; cure doom before it counts out; Defend through the knell.
BX27.lore: The Crown's great bell, sunk with Veyr. It rang once at the fault and has been trying to ring the right note since.

SB01.name: Cindermaw, the Surface Wyrm

sig.name: Caldera Heart
sig.tell: The caldera's glow drains into its mouth

phases.enter: Cindermaw's roar sets the ash alight.
The ancient dragon's fragment blazes through its scales.
It will not stop. It never has.

SB01.tell: The caldera's glow drains into its mouth
SB01.counterplay: Defend through the signature; exploit the weakness; bring revives.
SB01.lore: The oldest dragon that never gave up its fragment. It sleeps in the caldera and wakes to feed on towns.

SB02.name: Thalassar, the Sea Wyrm

sig.name: Tidefall
sig.tell: The sea pulls away from the shore

phases.enter: Thalassar's roar lifts the waves.
The ancient dragon's fragment blazes through its scales.
It will not stop. It never has.

SB02.tell: The sea pulls away from the shore
SB02.counterplay: Defend through the signature; exploit the weakness; bring revives.
SB02.lore: It coils under the Ember Sea. Sailors call the tide by its breathing.

SB03.name: Aerith-Vael, the Sky Wyrm

sig.name: Skybreak
sig.tell: The clouds split open above you

phases.enter: Aerith-Vael's roar is thunder.
The ancient dragon's fragment blazes through its scales.
It will not stop. It never has.

SB03.tell: The clouds split open above you
SB03.counterplay: Defend through the signature; exploit the weakness; bring revives.
SB03.lore: It flies the airship lanes and has never once landed. The storms are its wake.

SB04.name: Ossathrax, the Deep Wyrm

phases.enter: Ossathrax's roar shakes Emberdeep.
The ancient dragon's fragment blazes through its scales.
It will not stop. It never has.

SB04.counterplay: Defend through the signature; exploit the weakness; bring revives.
SB04.lore: Ruler of Emberdeep before the delvers came. It remembers the world when it was still hot.

SB05.name: CURATOR

purge.name: Purge
purge.tell: Every light in the Lattice goes out

phases.enter: CURATOR: 'You are running an old version. Updating.'
The Lattice powers down around you. All of it is going into CURATOR.
CURATOR: 'Curation complete. Beginning deletion.'

SB05.tell: Every light in the Lattice goes out
SB05.counterplay: Break both hands to slow its reindexing; Defend on the purge.
SB05.lore: The builder mind that sleeps at the Lattice's heart. The Crown's machine is a copy of it, badly made.

SB06.name: Mother Sepulchre, Unveiled

phases.enter: The veil falls. Nobody should see this face and live. You will have to try.
Every grave in the Hollow Throne opens.

SB06.counterplay: Light; doom and sleep cures; Defend on the grave.
SB06.lore: Her true face, under the veil she wears for the living.

SB07.name: Varro the Unbeaten

unbeaten.name: Unbeaten
unbeaten.tell: Varro points at one of you

phases.enter: Varro: 'Louder! They paid for louder!'
The crowd goes silent. Varro smiles for the first time in forty years.

SB07.tell: Varro points at one of you
SB07.counterplay: Cover the pointed-at ally; no weakness, only skill.
SB07.lore: Champion of the Crucible Isle for forty years. He has never lost, and he has never been happy.

SB08.name: The Choir That Remains

phases.enter: The Choir finds a voice it silenced long ago: yours.
It sings the requiem for everyone the Pale Choir took.

SB08.counterplay: Silence cures; storm; Defend in the pause.
SB08.lore: Every voice the Pale Choir silenced, still singing, under the Hollow Throne.

SB09.name: Hollow Heart: the Ledger

sig.name: What Was Taken
sig.tell: The ledger's pages turn by themselves

phases.enter: The keeper reaches the end of a column.
The keeper totals the book.

SB09.tell: The ledger's pages turn by themselves
SB09.counterplay: Defend on the total; water is weak.
SB09.lore: The first of the Hollow Heart's keepers. It counts everything the Crown ever took.

SB10.name: Hollow Heart: the Tally

phases.enter: The keeper reaches the end of a column.
The keeper totals the book.

SB10.counterplay: Defend on the total; fire is weak.
SB10.lore: The second keeper. It counts what the Crown ever gave back. The number is small.

SB11.name: Hollow Heart: the Verdict

phases.enter: The keeper reaches the end of a column.
The keeper totals the book.

SB11.counterplay: Defend on the total; light is weak.
SB11.lore: The third keeper. It weighs the two sums and says what they mean.

SB12.name: The Unmade Crown

unmake.name: Unmake
unmake.tell: The world goes quiet enough to hear your own names

phases.enter: The Unmade Crown looks for a head. It looks at each of you.
It tries all of you on at once.
It remembers it was never meant to be made.

SB12.counterplay: Break the circlet with water; light; Defend on the unmaking.
SB12.lore: What the Ashen Crown would have become if nobody had ever worn it. It wants a head.

E001@1.name: Rail Rat
E001@1.behavior: Bites the lowest current-HP front-row member; its tell is a short crouch.

E027@32.name: Frost Runner
E027@32.behavior: Fast ice bite, low HP; no unavoidable opening burst.

E039@32.name: Hollow Choirling
E039@32.behavior: Schedules a two-action Doom warning; player has cleanse and damage options.

E025@32.name: Ivory Sentinel

ops.text: Its sigil turns to face magic.

E025@32.behavior: Alternates physical guard and magic guard, visibly changing sigils.

E024@32.name: Sky Tick
E024@32.behavior: Applies Slow to one target, then rests.

E011@33.name: Pollen Bell
E011@33.behavior: Sleep pollen affects one target and cannot be reapplied before that target acts.

E027@33.name: Frost Runner
E027@33.behavior: Fast ice bite, low HP; no unavoidable opening burst.

E019@36.name: Bell Diver
E019@36.behavior: Alternates melee and a water spell; explicit undead tag permits hostile healing.

E018@36.name: Salt Leech
E018@36.behavior: Drain heals only actual HP damage dealt.

E029@36.name: Memory Shard
E029@36.behavior: Echoes a normal Attack once, using its own stats.

E035@36.name: Threshold Wisp
E035@36.behavior: Fire spell followed by a self-exposing recovery period.

E037@37.name: Broken Seraph
E037@37.behavior: Warns before light area damage; physically fragile.

E012@37.name: Bog Lantern

ops.text: The lantern's glow drifts toward its next target.

E012@37.behavior: Alternates water damage and a harmless lure animation that reveals its next target.

E019@37.name: Bell Diver
E019@37.behavior: Alternates melee and a water spell; explicit undead tag permits hostile healing.

E009@22.name: Briar Wolf
E009@22.behavior: Coordinated bite gains 10% if another wolf lives; capped at two wolves.

E012@22.name: Bog Lantern

ops.text: The lantern's glow drifts toward its next target.

E012@22.behavior: Alternates water damage and a harmless lure animation that reveals its next target.

E010@22.name: Root Mite
E010@22.behavior: Applies Poison only after a one-action sap tell.

E011@23.name: Pollen Bell
E011@23.behavior: Sleep pollen affects one target and cannot be reapplied before that target acts.

E009@23.name: Briar Wolf
E009@23.behavior: Coordinated bite gains 10% if another wolf lives; capped at two wolves.

D01_1.hint: Attack and Defend are always available.

D01_2.hint: The beetle shells up every other action - hit it while it is open.

D01_3.hint: Any direct hit interrupts the wisp's announced charge.

D01_4.hint: The hound marks its target before lunging. Defend the marked ally.

D01_T.hint: Choose Attack, then pick the rat.

D02_1.hint: Canal slimes split once when badly hurt.

D02_3.hint: Ledger moths return what they steal when defeated.

D03_4.hint: Burn or cleanse: fire is strong against the grove.

D04_2.hint: Hit the crab while pressure builds to weaken its burst.

D05_2.hint: Bell Divers are undead: healing magic hurts them.

D06_3.hint: The golem winds up slowly: Defend or finish it first.

B01.hint: Watch the red gauge: Defend the marked ally, strike the valve, or use the Storm Flask.

B02.hint: The warrant names its target before the restraint.

B03.hint: Burn the root before it binds the back row.

B04.hint: Ice and Defend blunt the boiler sweep.

B05.hint: The vibrating bell mirrors the last element used.

B06.hint: The shadow marks which row the dive will strike.

B07.hint: The sigil tells you whether skills or strength will be sealed.

B08.hint: Vary your commands; Defend through the echo.

B09.hint: Voss points at a protector before his orders.

B10.hint: Break an active relay or Defend when three lights show.

B11.hint: Strike the current valve before the surge notch.

B12.hint: Phase 1 separate targets; Phase 2 vary commands; Phase 3 Defend during the release.

B13.hint: Relight the dark lantern with fire to weaken its choice.

B14.hint: Beacons flash before the tide returns to the front row.

B15.hint: The screen names the edict - Defend or dispel.

B16.hint: Defend through silence; act through response.

OV_LICH.hint: The Lich King's court shatters under fire.

OV_MALDRATH.hint: Fallen knights still guard their king.

OV_KAEL.hint: Builder machines: storm finds the seams.

OV_RIDER.hint: Stop the engine before it builds speed.

OV_V09.hint: The grove tests whether you can protect it.

OV_V10.hint: The Thorn Queen's brood: cure poison early.

OV_V11.hint: Ice and water cool the wyrm's brood.

BX01.hint: Storm cracks his oath; Defend when the bells ring.

BX02.hint: Ice and water crack the slag; cleanse burns.

BX03.hint: Storm is strong; wake sleepers fast.

BX04.hint: Earth grounds her; watch her shadow.

BX05.hint: Ice first, fire when all heads rise; light the weeping head.

BX06.hint: Fire and light; cure poison after the censer.

BX07.hint: Water douses foxfire; protect the marked one.

BX08.hint: Fire, and Defend in the silence.

BX10.hint: Shadow; stop its hymn; Defend on the chord.

BX13.hint: Hit the core; Defend on demolition.

BX16.hint: Storm or water; break the cab.

BX22.hint: Light; cure doom; Defend on the embrace.

BX27.hint: Earth dulls it; cure doom; Defend on the knell.

SB01.hint: Defend on the signature; ice is weak.

SB02.hint: Defend on the signature; storm is weak.

SB03.hint: Defend on the signature; earth is weak.

SB04.hint: Defend on the signature; water is weak.

SB05.hint: Break the hands; Defend on the purge.

SB08.hint: Storm; cure silence; Defend in the pause.

SB09.hint: water is weak; Defend on the total.

SB10.hint: fire is weak; Defend on the total.

SB11.hint: light is weak; Defend on the total.

SB12.hint: Light; break the circlet; Defend on the unmaking.

CH19.name: The Hand That Wrote the Seal

Q01.name: A Shield Nobody Asked For
Q01.hook: Mara asks Dain to help identify the workers erased from the quarry ledger
Q01.objectives: Recover three named records from the surface memorial and safe salvage route; speak to the families; let Mara choose the inscription
Q01.decision: Dain tries to add his confession to the memorial. Mara gives him a separate place to record it: the workers' names are not a stage for his redemption
Q01.result: Dain and Ilyr agree on an explicit right to end their shared-body accord

Q02.name: A Lantern Left Burning
Q02.hook: A former apprentice asks Tessa to teach a technique that will not exhaust its user
Q02.objectives: Collect observations at three inhabited lantern stations; test a low-power circuit with the apprentice; return to the flooded gallery
Q02.decision: Tessa must leave the apprentice alone to solve the last fault rather than taking over
Q02.result: She establishes a small public workshop and shares the credit

Q03.name: The Returners' Wall
Q03.hook: Edda wants a record of rescues, not only deaths
Q03.objectives: Find a damaged flight recorder; interview a survivor; repair a landing marker with the local crew
Q03.decision: Corren reads the unedited account of the cable he cut and does not demand that it be balanced by his later deeds
Q03.result: The hall adds a returners' wall and an incident archive

Q04.name: The Unborrowed Engine
