A builder bulkhead seals the tunnel. It hums, and does not open.
A builder bulkhead seals the tunnel. It hums, and does not open.

entities.text: Hollins Mill. Grind by the sack, tithe by the Crown. Fishing pond west of the lane.
The end of the dock. The water is brown and patient.
The mill wheel. Its paddles are patched with three different colours of Crown crate.
The well rope is new. The bucket is older than the Crown.
A millstone. Someone has scratched a tally into the rim: every sack the Crown took this year.
A flood ledger kept since the mill was built. The last entry: 'Crown dredgers came. River went wrong.'
The Gallowgate bounty board.
A waystone among the carts, polished by a thousand waiting hands.

N02_HALL.name: Gallowgate Toll - Canteen and Bounty Office

entities.text: The orchard bell, hung at the old grove gate. Its rope is tied off with a black ribbon.
A picker's grave marker.
Wren's Orchard. Cider by the cask. The old grove is closed after dark.
The press stones. The third one sits a finger higher than the others.
A family ledger. Harl's hand stops in the autumn of the harvest levy. Wren's hand carries on, smaller.

entities.msg: A side door, barred from the inside.

entities.text: A toppled statue of an oath-knight. The inscription: 'WE HOLD UNTIL RELIEVED.'

entities.msg: A rusted portcullis. A bell rope hangs by the west pews.
An iron grille across the reliquary stair. It shivers when a bell rings somewhere to the west.

entities.text: The nave floor slopes into a baptismal font. The water in it is perfectly still, and warm.
A waterlogged roster nailed to a pillar: forty oath-knights, 'to hold the chapel until relieved'. No relief is listed.
The reliquary. Forty oath-rings in a drowned velvet tray, green with age.
The high altar, under a finger of water.

entities.msg: A round stone seals the barrow. Words are cut around its rim, half worn away.

entities.text: A standing stone. A crown is carved on it, then chiselled out, then carved again.
A standing stone. A name is carved on it. It has been scratched out so hard the stone is scored.
A stone sarcophagus with an empty crown-shaped hollow in its lid.
Grave goods on a shelf: a knight's gauntlet, a child's shoe, a Crown seal older than any in Veyr.
A tablet: 'HERE HE LAY, THE FIRST TIME. THE CROWN WAS TAKEN FROM HIM AND CARRIED BACK TO THE FIRST HEAD.'
A seam of dull ore breaks the ledge, marked with a miner's chalk X.
A second seam, glinting. The chalk mark says: 'LEAVE FOR THE NEW ONES'.
A sluice gate in the dam face. Water weeps around its edges like it has been crying for years.
KETTLE ROW. Slag Guild of the Reach. The dam is INSPECTED. Do not stand under the sluices.

N06_INN.name: Kettle Row - The Slag and Kettle

entities.text: A mural of the first slag-miners, coughing proudly.

entities.msg: A slag chute mouth, choked with cooled clinker from above.

entities.text: A cairn of cooled slag, shaped like a man. Someone has given it a hat.

entities.msg: Molten slag runs across the ford. It would cool if the vent above were opened.
The upper stair is buried in soft, smoking clinker.

entities.text: A vent valve, rusted open a crack. Painted on the housing: 'OPEN TO COOL THE FORD. SLAG GUILD.'
A crucible the size of a house, cracked in half. Slag still drips from the lip, slow as honey.
A cooling pool, steaming. The Slag Guild's runners soak their boots here before the last climb.

N07_R05.name: The Slagfalls - Crown of the Falls

entities.text: The source of the falls: a furnace flue from the Crown works above, pouring slag down the mountain day and night.
The Great Anvil, older than the Crown. Hundreds of smiths' marks are struck into its face.
A pilgrim's anvil. Struck into it: a hammer, a date, and 'FOR MY FATHER'.
A pilgrim's anvil, cracked clean through. Someone struck it too hard, or too sadly.
ANVIL CAIRN. Leave an anvil, take a blessing. Smiths of the Reach, welcome.
The steam organ: forty pipes of scavenged brass. It plays one chord at noon, loud enough to scare the crows off the ridge.
THE PIPEWRIGHT'S REST - beds, stew, and the only hot bath between Cinderwake and the sky.
WEND'S AGENT - GOODS. Closed on feast days, and on days the viaduct sways.
Past the railing: a long, long drop, full of mist and the sound of water.
A copper bath, fed by a pipe from the viaduct boilers. The water is almost too hot. Almost.
Blueprints for the viaduct, signed by three generations of Pipewrights. The newest adds a note: 'The east piers are shifting.'

entities.msg: The cave mouth is plugged with a single slab of cooled glass, warm to the touch. Something behind it is breathing.

entities.text: The seal on the lair.
A crystal of cooled dragon-breath, clear as glass. Something small and scaled is frozen inside it.
A second crystal. Inside it, a scale the size of a door.
Scorch marks climb the rim in a spiral, as if something coiled here to sleep and turned over once a century.
The Oathstone: a milestone taller than a house. Four faces, four roads, and a fifth face nobody reads aloud.
A waystone, humming faintly.

entities.msg: The service door is packed with mud to the lintel. The galleries beyond are silent.
A maintenance hatch, bolted from inside.
The hatch is buried under a slope of dam-stone.

entities.text: A gauge post. The needle has been wired to point at SAFE.

entities.msg: The walkway is under a fast black current.

entities.text: A painted notice: 'SLUICE ONE diverts the gallery race. Pull ONLY in an emergency.' Someone has added: 'it is one'.

entities.msg: A floodgate seals the keeper's stair. The valve for it is out on the race.

entities.text: Valve schedule, in the keeper's hand: 'Open two, close one, pray.' Below, in a different hand: 'I stopped praying. I started holding.'
The keeper's log, last page: 'Crown says hold the water for the furnaces. Village below says let it out. I am one man with two hands.'
A made bed, two pillows. One is still dented.
The crest walk. Below you, very small, the roofs of Kettle Row.

entities.msg: A gap between two ribs, jammed with fallen vertebrae.

entities.text: A rib the height of a house, rising out of the plain. Carved at its root, by dragonborn hands, very old: a name.

entities.msg: Vertebrae lock together across the way, like a jaw shut tight.
Vertebrae lock together across the way, like a jaw shut tight.

entities.text: The walk along the spine. On either side, nothing: the Scar falls away into the dark for a long way.

entities.msg: The throat of the ribcage is shut by a knot of fused bone.

entities.text: A fragment-crystal grown out of the bone, dark and cold. Nothing remembers in it anymore.
An altar of dragonborn make, set into the jawbone. Offerings: scales, teeth, a child's clay dragon.

P01_R05.name: Spine of Ilyrath - The Marrow Nest

entities.text: The dragon's heart-cavity. The bone around it is scorched from the inside.
A builder road sign, bent but legible: MILE 0. RING HIGHWAY - ALL LANES.
A builder statue with a measuring rod. Someone has hung a Crown helmet on its head, then thought better of it and taken it off.

entities.msg: A fresh course of masonry, laid across the shaft this morning. A console blinks at the top of the west column.
A course of masonry walls the shaft, still settling. A console hums on the far side.

entities.text: Between the courses: a gap where the tower ends and the sky begins. Wind comes up out of the plain.

entities.msg: The stair up is walled with this morning's course. The traffic console is dark.
A builder service lift. Its cage is chained at the top of the shaft.

entities.text: Traffic log, lane 1.
Traffic log, lane 6.
The dispatch relay: a console with a single lit key.
A survey tent, abandoned. A notebook: 'The tower adds one course every dawn. At this rate it reaches the clouds in eleven years. Why?'
The dispatch console of the Ring Highway, still warm.
The governor core's cradle, empty and humming.

entities.msg: A rope gate across the shelf stair. A painted board: 'SHELF CLOSED - ASK THE WARDEN.'

entities.text: The Rock's spring: a cracked cistern, barely wet.
REFUGE ROCK. All who walk out of the ruin are welcome. Work if you can. Eat either way.
Crates stencilled CROWN PROVISION - COASTAL GARRISON. Most are empty. Someone has been sharing them out, fairly.
A Crown desalination still, salvaged and patched. It drips fresh water into a bucket, one drop a breath.
A lamp in a niche: the old lighthouse lens, cracked, set in the wall like a saint's relic.
The council table is a ship's hatch cover on crates. Names are carved around the edge - everyone who has arrived.

entities.msg: The tower door is shut with a keeper's lock: a bronze plate with a lantern-shaped keyhole.

entities.text: A cairn of stones on the ledge, with a lantern set on top. Under the lantern, a body in a keeper's coat.
The cable lift to the lower harbour. The cable hangs in the sea.
THE LAST BEACON. Signal Company of the Skyspine. When it burns, every lamp that sees it answers.
The great lamp of the Last Beacon: a lens of a thousand prisms around an empty fire-cup.
A griffon nest woven from signal flags. The colours are all the colours of 'HELP'.
The keepers' signal book. The last line: 'Fault. All stations dark. Holding on for relief.'
The Keel and Lantern. Beds, soup, no questions about where the timber came from.
Salvage Exchange. We buy what the sea gives back. We sell what it didn't want.
Tide board: LOW at the second bell, HIGH at dusk. Nobody goes into the hulls on a rising tide.
A split in the hull where the tide has left something bright wedged in the ribs.
Barnacled ironwork glints under the weed. A salvage node.
The stern plate is still legible: 'CROWN TITHE BARGE 11. Property of the Ministry of Waterways.'
FERRIES from Belltower Point: north to Skyspine at the first bell; out to Saltwhistle when the guild flag flies. Pay the boatman, not the Ministry.
Coastal lighthouse. Lamp lit at dusk by order of nobody. The keeper does it anyway.
A cairn of cracked bronze. Names of bellringers lost to the sea, one line per storm. The newest line is still bright.
The sea-stair: iron rungs down the rock into the water. Before the fault it went to the fishing ledge. Now it goes to Old Bellharbor.
Stairs up to the lamp room. The oil smell comes down them like weather.
Galloway Lampworks. Wicks trimmed, glass blown, grief lit. Knock loud; the kilns roar.
Closed for mourning. The Tallow family asks for quiet on the upper lane.
NIGHT MARKET: stalls open when the lamps do. Anything that burns, anything that glows.

entities.msg: A rope ladder's frayed end hangs in the dark far above. It was hauled up from the other side.

entities.text: Chalked on the rock: KEEP OUT. BY ORDER OF NOBODY YOU WANT TO MEET.
A smugglers' skiff, stove in. Someone scratched a tally of trips into the gunwale. It stops at forty-one.

entities.msg: Seawater pours through the gap in the rock. A sluice wheel somewhere could turn it aside.
The channel runs deep with the tide. A second sluice must hold it back.

entities.text: A brass plate on the wheel housing: 'Sluice 1 of 2. Builder work, older than the Crown. Turn slowly.'
Rope burns on the rock, and the scuffs of heavy crates dragged north. The smugglers came this way at low tide.

N13_R03.name: The Brine Stair - Stair of Pools

entities.msg: An iron tide-gate, padlocked from this side. The smugglers kept the key on someone.

entities.text: A drowned smuggler, wedged between the pools. A key on a cord round his neck.
Moss grows thick on the west wall. Below, in the flooded bay, something catches the light.

entities.msg: A rope ladder, coiled and lashed to an iron ring. Loosing it would drop a way down to the sea mouth.

entities.text: The smugglers' ledger, weighted with a stone. Columns: DATE. CARGO. PAID TO HER. The last column is always the same: 'one man'.
A crate of diving gear under oilcloth: a helmet of thick sea-glass, bolted into a brass collar.
Behind the pool: a shelf of tarred boxes. Receipts. Hundreds. Each one a name the smugglers never wrote down.
FISHING TOURNAMENT. Sign up with Tourney Master Oyle in the Guild Hall. Biggest catch takes the Silver Hook.
The guild flag. Green: passengers. Red: tournament. Black: all boats out.
The guild well. Fresh water on a salt island; the guild guards it closer than its records.
The record board: the biggest fish ever landed on Saltwhistle, in chalk, rubbed out and rewritten for sixty years.

N14_SHOP.name: Saltwhistle Isle - Guild Tackle and Stores

entities.msg: A cairn of sea-stones, fitted too tightly to be chance. Gulls nest in every gap.

entities.text: A cairn of sea-stones, fitted too tightly to be chance.
A smuggler's cutter, hauled up and tarred. Its name has been burned off. Its cargo hold is lined with lead.
Tally marks on the cliff, in groups of five. Next to the last group: 'enough'.

entities.msg: A shepherds' gate across the ridge path, tied shut: 'HIGH PASTURE. FLOCKS ONLY.'

entities.text: Windrest. Wool, horn, and the best brackhorns on the Skyspine. The wind is free and there is too much of it.
Harl's Brackhorn Stables. Breaking, shoeing, stabling. Bramble's cousins, most of them.
A stall with a brass plate: BRAMBLE. Empty. Fresh straw anyway. Maddoc says she'll be back; they always come back.

entities.msg: The road simply stops. Forty feet of wind where it used to be.

entities.text: The view: Windrest far below, the new sea glinting where the lowlands were. The cliff road lies in the valley in pieces.
The wind altar: a basin of stone scoured smooth. Nine grooves run out from it to nine poles. The wind fills them in turn.
The North pole's bell: 'The wind that brings snow. Ask it for nothing; it has nothing.'
The Northeast bell: 'The wind that carries the cable. Thank it at both ends.'
The East bell: 'The sea wind. It smells of other people's harbours.'
The Southeast bell: 'The warm wind. It lies.'
The South bell: 'The wind at your back. It is not yours; it is only going your way.'
The Southwest bell: 'The wind off the salt. It keeps what it touches.'
The West bell: 'The wind that goes over the edge. It comes back as weather.'
The Northwest bell: 'The high wind. Nobody has ever heard it land.'
The ninth pole has no bell, only a groove worn in the stone. 'The wind that stopped. Listen for it.'
The cable house: the sky cable runs out over the drop toward the Shattered Choir and Crucible Isle. The winch is locked.
The shrine's book of winds. Every page records one day's weather, and one line of what somebody asked for.

entities.msg: A roc-feather rope hangs from the ledge above, well out of reach.

entities.text: A poachers' camp: a cart for eggs, a tent for the poachers. The tent is torn from the top. The cart is empty.

entities.msg: A wind-shutter of lashed timber, braced shut. The updraft screams through the slats.
A second wind-shutter, braced from the ledge on the far side of the chasm.

entities.text: The updraft: warm air pours up out of the chasm. Feathers ride it, turning, never falling.

entities.msg: A wall of woven branches and old bone. Rocs let their own kind through. Everyone else, they eat.

entities.text: A nest of four eggs, each the size of a barrel, warm as bread. One has a poacher's chalk mark on it.
An empty nest. Egg-shell and a snapped rope. Somebody got one out. Somebody didn't get far.
A great roc feather, gold at the root, stuck in the branches. The nest-wall smells of it.

entities.msg: A rope of plaited roc feathers, coiled round a spur. Let it down and it would reach Nestfall Ledge.

entities.text: Moulted feathers, drifts of them, gold and grey. Beyond the cave mouth, a nest the size of a house.
The queen's nest, lined with gold feathers and poachers' rope. Among the down, one egg, and one very small roc.
Lilac Seep Mineral Co-operative. We grow what the ground gives. We do not grow what the Crown orders.
A seep pool: brine wells up from below and leaves lilac crystal on every stick set in it. The sticks are labelled with names.
Seep pool, fenced. A slate: 'RESTING. Pool gave too much last season. Let it think.'
A glass tree, taller than a house. Its fruit are small, perfect, empty spheres of crystal. They ring when the wind touches them.
A felled glass tree, cut clean through. The stump is still growing, slowly, a new tree out of the old one's glass.
The orchard wall is builder stone. Old marks on it: nine small circles in a ring, one of them filled in.

N20_R02.name: The Glass Orchard - The Heart Tree

entities.text: The Heart Tree. Inside the glass, very deep, something like a figure curled asleep. It is not a tree. It never was.
A plinth of builder stone, carved: 'SEED VESTIGE 03. Grown, not made. Do not wake without consent.'
A second plinth, blank but for a handprint worn into the stone by a great many hands.

entities.msg: Dark water, and far out on it, a single lamp on an island. There is no boat on this side.

entities.text: A cairn of small offerings: a child's shoe, a letter, a wedding cord. Left so the lake would take the memory and leave the grief.
A second cairn. A slate: 'I came to forget her. I couldn't. I stayed three days. Then I went home and remembered her properly.'

entities.msg: The causeway sinks under black water here. Names are cut into the stones below the surface.
The causeway runs on under the water toward the drowned village. Too deep to wade.

entities.text: A drowned lamp-post, relit by someone once and gone out again. The names on the causeway stones stop halfway across.
Names cut into the causeway, thousands of them. Every one the lake has taken. Most have been rubbed smooth by hands.

entities.msg: The lane out of the village is under the lake. Far off, a drowned bell hangs silent in the chapel tower.

entities.text: The chapel bell, still in its tower, the rope trailing into the water.
A house door, open. Inside, under a foot of water, a table set for four. Nobody has touched it.
A window. Through it: a cradle, floating. Empty. Rocking a little in the current.
Rubble where a wall was. On the lintel: 'Merrow's Bakery. Est. before anyone remembers.' Nobody remembers.
A shop sign, face-down in the shallows: 'Ferris and Daughters, Rope.' The lake took the town. It left the signs.

N21_R04.name: Sorrowmere - Isle of the Last Lamp

entities.msg: Black water between the island and the shore. A raft is tied up on this side.

entities.text: The last lamp: a lantern on a pole, burning without oil. Its light makes the water around the island clear to the bottom.
Where the Mere-Mother sank, the water is clear. On the bottom: a village, and another, and another, all very small, all asleep.
The cable house. Its door is nailed shut and painted: 'CLOSED. CABLE TO CRUCIBLE ISLE RE-RIGGING. ASK THE ANCHORMASTER.'
The anchor winch: a builder drum wound with a cable as thick as a man. It hums. The cable runs down into the cloud toward the Ninefold Shrine.
An old mooring chain, rusted to the rock. Stamped on every link: 'SERAPHEL. PROPERTY OF THE HOST.'

entities.msg: A collapsed arch. Something on the far side is holding it up; a latch, maybe.

entities.text: A statue of a winged soldier, sword reversed, face worn away by wind. The plinth: 'WE ANSWER.'
A fallen sentinel statue. Someone has set its sword back in its hands.
A sentinel statue, facing outward, still on watch over a sky with nothing in it.

entities.msg: A gate of silver bars, tuned like pipes. It hums one note, waiting for a second.
A second silver gate, humming a different note.

entities.text: The muster roll, cut into the wall under the statues of the host: nine hundred names, in nine columns.
A lectern with a hymn-book chained to it. Every hymn is an order: 'Hold.' 'Descend.' 'Answer.' 'Hold.'

entities.msg: Far out on the wind, the wreck of something vast drifts on its chains. The chain-bridge to it is drawn up.

entities.text: The walk narrows to a single span of white stone. Below it: cloud, and far below the cloud, the World of Ruin.

entities.msg: A collapsed arch, braced from this side with an iron latch-bar.

entities.text: Vestments on hooks, white and gold, each tagged with a name from the muster roll. Nine hundred hooks. Most are empty.
The conductor's stand. A baton of white metal lies on it, still warm.
The great organ's keyboard: five manuals of white keys, cracked, and a single key held down by a wedge of stone.
A stop, pulled out, labelled in the host's script: HOLD.
A stop, pushed in, labelled: ANSWER. Someone pushed it in very hard; the knob is bent.
A stop, half out, labelled: DESCEND. Dust on it. Nobody has touched it in thirty years.

entities.locked_msg: The Ward gate is chained shut. A Board seal: NO ENTRY, NO EXIT, BY ORDER.

entities.text: BOARD OF QUARANTINE: Coughing is to be reported. Weeping is to be reported. Grey skin is to be reported at once.
Harrowfen Board Hall. Petitions heard on the third bell. Petitions granted: none this year.

entities.msg: The east footbridge burned down to the pilings.

entities.text: Rookery Row. The beaks roost here. So did the doctors.

entities.msg: Burned timbers block the west lane.

entities.text: The lazar-house door is nailed shut from outside. Someone inside is knocking, slowly, in threes.
A Board placard, scorched: CLEANSING ORDER 12. Upon breach of the wall, the Ward is to be purified by fire.
Licence ledger, Board copy. Entry 7: The Mirewold Remedy. Sole right of sale: the Order of Saint Lamprey, under Crown seal.
Death rolls for the Ward, by week. The columns get narrower. Then someone stopped ruling new ones.

N22_CHAPEL.name: Harrowfen - Chapel of the Beaked Order

entities.text: A mural: beaked doctors walking into a grey city, carrying lanterns. One of them is walking the other way.
A physician's daybook in a narrow hand: Brewed forty doses. Taught the eel-wife to brew ten. Better.
BY ORDER OF THE BOARD: The road is closed from the curfew bell to the dawn bell. Offenders will be displayed.
A cold campfire ring. Somebody has left kindling stacked, and a warning scratched on a stone: DON'T WAIT FOR DARK.

entities.locked_msg: The old causeway to Harrowfen runs east from here, dry and well-kept.

entities.text: SICKLE HAMLET. Reapers, reeds, remedies. Do not eat anything you did not see grow.

N24_SHOP.name: Sickle Hamlet - Granny Sedge's Herb House

entities.text: A Board milestone, half sunk: HARROWFEN 4 MILES. Someone has scratched out the 4 and written DROWNED.

entities.locked_msg: A portcullis, rusted shut. The winch must be on the other side.

entities.text: Saint Lamprey, patron of the letting of blood. The plinth reads: HE DRINKS THAT YOU MAY BE CLEAN.

entities.locked_msg: The choir door has three locks shaped like leeches. Two are open. The third wants a key.

entities.msg: The west basin is brim-full. A sluice lever stands in the south aisle.
The east basin is brim-full. Its sluice is worked from somewhere else.
Dark water, and something moving in it.

entities.text: A bleeding basin. The drain is choked with leeches the size of a hand, all asleep, all fat.
The abbot's sale book. Mirewold Remedy, formula and all rights, to the Crown Ministry. Price: the Order's tithe for life.
Tithe rolls. Harrowfen pays by the head of the sick. Every year there are more heads. Every year the Order is richer.
Novice's slate: The abbot has stopped eating. He says the leeches feed him now. I have asked to be moved.

entities.locked_msg: Steps up to a portcullis. Its winch is beside you.

entities.msg: An iron grille. Somewhere a lever rattles it.
An iron grille across the north walk, locked from the far side.

entities.text: Twin statues of the Saint, mouths open. Between them, carved small: THE KEY IS KEPT WHERE THE SAINT LAYS HIS HEAD.
The leech-well. It goes down further than a well should. The water in it is warm.
A moth carved in the stone, wings open wide enough to cover a town. Under it, older letters: SHE BURNED SO THE FEN COULD BREATHE.
KAMINARI FORD. The strait ferry sails from the east jetty (board it from the world map). Lanterns for the river: two copper.
A small fox shrine. Offerings: rice, a copper, a paper mask with no face painted on it yet.

entities.name: A girl with a sly smile

N27_INN.name: Kaminari Ford - The Lantern Wake Inn

entities.msg: The maples whisper, and the path you took is the path you came in by.
Red leaves swirl. You are back at the edge of the wood.
A fox laughs somewhere. The trees have moved.
You walk out of the maples - into the maples, at the place you started.

entities.text: A stone lantern by the shrine, unlit. The wick is new.
An altar with two cups and a folded veil. Nobody has married here in daylight.
SHIROYAMA. The watch-keep of the fox court. Held for the Empress. (Someone has added: STILL.)
The keep well. A bucket still hangs on the rope. The water tastes of iron and maple.
Over the parapet: the strait, grey and wide, and far off the lantern-lights of the other shore.
The keep's signal beacon: an iron basket of old pine and lamp-oil, waiting.

entities.name: A sentry who is not there

entities.text: AKAGANE. By grace of the Fox Court: masks to be worn above the canal. Faces are for family.

entities.msg: The west bridge has fallen into the canal.
The east bridge is a heap of red timber.

entities.text: THE COURT OF MASKS. Petitioners wear the mask of their station. The Court does not see faces.

entities.msg: The west terrace has slid into the gardens.

entities.text: Behind the dais: nine empty masks on nine hooks, one for each tail of the Empress. The ninth hook is bare.

N28_SHRINE.name: Akagane - Shrine of the White Fox

entities.text: A white fox in stone, eyes shut. Offerings of fried tofu, and a mask cut in half.
A stone fox. Its plaque: ONE THOUSAND GATES, AND ONE OF THEM IS TRUE. THE COURT DOES NOT SAY WHICH.

N29_R02.name: Thousand Gates - The Gates That Repeat

entities.msg: You step through the gate - and out of the gate you entered by. The foxes laugh.
Through the gate, and back at the foot of the maze. The same gate. It is always the same gate.
Red pillars, red pillars, red pillars - and the entrance again.

entities.text: A black fox statue, lamp dark. It stares east, deep into the maze, towards its white twin.
A white fox statue with an oil lamp in its paws. It looks north-west, very pointedly.

entities.msg: You step into the painting and out onto the approach stair.
A fox gate barred with red lacquer. A red mask hangs somewhere in this hall.
A fox gate barred with white lacquer.
A painted gate. Only a painting - from this side.

entities.text: Two statues back to back. One faces the red walk, one the white. Between them: WHAT THE COURT SEES IS WHAT THE COURT BELIEVES.

entities.msg: A fallen maple lies across the stair, lashed with shrine rope.

entities.locked_msg: A bailiff's bell hangs in the doorway. The court sits only when a case is called, and none is.

entities.text: Case rolls, thousands, each ending the same: VERDICT UPHELD. Not one reads OVERTURNED.
RIMEHOLT. Last hearth before the ice. Furs bought, furs sold, nobody turned away in a storm.
The ice here is black and thin. A sled runner sticks out of it, and nothing else.
An abandoned climbers' tent. A diary: DAY 9. THE MOUNTAIN IS WARM INSIDE. IT SHOULD NOT BE WARM INSIDE.

N34_R02.name: Glacier Spire - Hall of Frozen Falls

entities.msg: A curtain of frozen falls. The way round is east, by the thaw-gap.
The upper falls are frozen solid.
The ice bridge has sheared away. A winch on the far ledge might swing the rope-bridge across.

entities.text: Climbers' carving on a boulder: ROPE-BRIDGE WINCH BELOW. TURN IT BEFORE THE GUIDES GET BACK.

entities.msg: You sit, push off, and the chute takes you all the way down to the foot of the spire.

entities.text: A polished ice chute plunges down the outside of the spire. Going down would be quick. Coming back up would not.
A climbers' fire, still warm. The warmth is coming up through the rock, not from the ashes.
The rim. Far down, where no light should be, something is lit. The Crown's iron cap covers the rest.
A Crown survey post: GREAT PIT No. 3. CAPPED. DEPTH NOT MEASURED. DO NOT MEASURE.

entities.locked_msg: A sally-port in the citadel wall, frozen shut from inside.

entities.text: An ice-crowned statue. The plinth: COLDHARBOUR, SEAT OF THE NORTH. IT DID NOT FALL. IT WAS KEPT.

entities.locked_msg: The barbican gate is locked in a yard of ice. Heat would loosen it.

entities.text: The ward well, frozen to the brim. Scratched on the rim: LIGHT THE THREE AND THE GATE WEEPS.

entities.msg: A portcullis of black iron, rimed white.
The inner portcullis. Its winch must be in the middle hall.
This portcullis rusted shut long ago.

entities.text: A courtier frozen mid-bow. Frost has grown over her like lace. Her eyes follow you. They should not be able to.
A soldier of the old north, spear grounded, three hundred winters on watch. Under the ice his lips are moving.
A child in court silks, frozen holding a lantern that was never lit.
A brazier of blue fire that gives no heat. Carved above the doors: THE WARDEN KEEPS THE SEAT. THE SEAT KEEPS THE COURT.

entities.locked_msg: The inner court is sealed behind a yard of blue ice. It is not waiting for you.

entities.text: The seal on the inner court. Carved in the ice, a crown - and under it, a line that will not stay legible.
The Rime Throne. Empty. The frost on the seat has the shape of someone who sat there for a very long time.
A stair cut down into the ice, going further than the citadel's foundations. Cold air rises from it, and faint singing.
A lift cage on its side, cable coiled like a dead snake.
The cooled crossing.
West: Anvil & Ale. East: Forge Ward. Up: the King's Terrace. Down: the Deep, and whatever's in it.
THE MASTER FORGE. Crown work at the back of the queue.
CROWN FACTOR - DEEP ACCOUNTS. Knock. Wait.
The Miners' Memorial.
Sealed by order of the Crown Factor: tenant in arrears.
A strongbox, locked.
A Crown valve wheel, chained.
The Ember-Well. Breathe slowly near the edge.

entities.locked_msg: A slab of crystal seals the passage. It rings faintly from the far side.

entities.text: A delver's warning post.

U04_R02.name: The Geode Wood - Glade of Chimes

entities.msg: A wall of crystal, whole and humming. Somewhere the wood's light is being bent the wrong way.

entities.text: A humming crystal node.
A humming crystal node.
A humming crystal node.
A prism-reader's slate.

entities.msg: Crystal grown shut. Light moves inside it, looking for a way out.

entities.locked_msg: The crystal slab is still whole on this side. A crack runs down it.

entities.text: Bones in a gatherer's coat.
Carved into a wing bone.

entities.locked_msg: A lattice of bone fills the arch. It shivers when you touch it, like a held note.

entities.text: Lines scratched in the floor.
A dragon's vertebra, split open.

entities.msg: A chasm. The ledge above is out of reach from here.

entities.text: The great skull's jaw.
MAGMA FERRY. Skiffs to Cinderlake Isles on the bell. Hands inside the boat.

entities.msg: Lava, where the boardwalk was. The west isle is a black hump in the glow.
The east boardwalk is under the lake.
The west boardwalk has sunk.

entities.locked_msg: A rockfall, packed tight. Charges are stacked on the far side, by the sound of the dripping.

entities.text: CROWN DEEP WORKS. AUTHORISED LABOUR ONLY. QUOTA IS KINDNESS.
A labourer's tally, cut into a tent pole.

U08_R02.name: The Crown Dig - Barracks and Office

entities.locked_msg: A Crown gate. The lock takes a brass shift token; there's a board for them in the office.

entities.text: The foreman's desk.
A board of brass shift tokens.

entities.msg: The belt runs full of ore, fast enough to take a leg off.
The lower belt screams past, loaded with rock.

entities.locked_msg: Packed rock. A good charge would open it.

entities.text: Crates stencilled BLASTING POWDER.
A speaking tube, brass, running down to the face.

U08_R06.name: The Crown Dig - The Dig Face

entities.text: The sealed altar in the roots.

entities.msg: The air thickens into something like a wall. Whatever sleeps beyond will not be seen by strangers.

entities.text: Claw-marks on the cave wall.
The heart-stone.
VAULTMOUTH RAIL. Karag Dun - Deepforge. Keep hands in the cart, heads below the beam.

entities.msg: A loaded ore cart sits across the gallery, brake welded on by rust.
A cart blocks the upper gallery. The points lever for this line must be somewhere else.

entities.text: A chalked board of the gallery points.
A seam of heartsteel in the rock.
A seam of heartsteel in the rock.
A seam of heartsteel in the rock.
The Name-Carver's stones.
An echo stone, worn smooth.
An echo stone, worn smooth.
An echo stone, worn smooth.
A dormant automaton.
MERIDIAN. East: Keepers' Market. West: the Stacks. North: the Keepers' Hall. Speak quietly; the city is sleeping.
An orders kiosk, screen dark.
An orders kiosk. The screen is dark glass with dust in the corners. Nothing you do wakes it.

entities.locked_msg: A freight lift, dead. Its call-plate is on the far side.

entities.text: A production board, still counting.

entities.locked_msg: A pressure door, unpowered. Its lamp is dark.
A pressure door, unpowered. The breaker for this bank is somewhere else on the floor.

entities.text: A wiring plate.
The K-series line record.

entities.locked_msg: The freight lift is dead. Its call-plate is right here, though.

entities.text: A rejected frame in a scrap bin.
A standby rack, one slot empty.

entities.locked_msg: A reading-room shutter, bolted from the far side.

entities.text: A reading desk. Glass slates, each a single page that never fades. Most now read: PENDING DELETION.
An index drum, turning slowly. The builders filed things by what they were for, not what they were called.

entities.msg: A catalogue gate. Three drawers must be pulled in the order the builders filed them.

entities.text: Brass plate: 'FOUNDING before LATTICE before RELAY. Pull in the order of making.'
A reading engine with its drawer half open. Something glows inside.

entities.msg: The incinerator mouth. Slates slide in and do not come out.

entities.text: A sorting desk. Slates stamped with the Crown's seal are sorted first. Someone gave that order recently.
A conveyor stopped mid-feed. Wedged under the belt, a slate that is still warm.

entities.locked_msg: The shutter is bolted. The bolt is on this side, low on the wall.

entities.text: Two statues of builders, faces worn smooth, holding an open book between them. The book is a screen. It says: INDEX AWAKE.
The Index's reading terminal, low enough to reach from the floor.

entities.msg: The undersea link tunnel. A builder seal, rated for pressure. It will not open for anything that cannot dive.

entities.text: A pressure plaque by the tunnel seal: 'LINK TUNNEL 4 - TO SEA FLOOR - VESSELS ONLY.'
A builder gauge: GLASSWATER LEVEL 94%. The needle has not moved since the fault. It is correct.
An overpass pillar, painted over and over: lane numbers, then prayers, then tally marks.
A wrecked cart from the builders' era. No horse fittings. The seat faces a wheel that steers.

U22_R02.name: The Highway That Was - The Last Toll

entities.text: Sign, builder script under a keeper's chalk translation: 'LAST SERVICE BEFORE THE BRIDGE. BRIDGE: CLOSED.'
A toll booth. A light inside still blinks: WAITING FOR UNIT.

entities.locked_msg: A service hatch. Locked from the armoury side.

entities.text: The vault door lies split along a fault line. Builder letters on the halves: OMEGA - OPERATIVE STORAGE - DO NOT WAKE WITHOUT ORDERS.

entities.msg: A bulkhead, unpowered. A breaker panel is somewhere on this floor.

entities.text: Capsule K-03: empty. The label is scratched out and rewritten by hand: 'He asked to be let out. We let him out.'
Capsule K-07: empty, frosted inside. The frost has the shape of someone sitting up.
Capsule K-09: empty. The cable to its order-port has been cut cleanly.

U23_R03.name: Vault Omega - Hall of Standing Orders

entities.msg: A second bulkhead. The breaker is in the hall, behind the statues.

entities.text: Mural of orders, row one: KAEL-01 HOLD THE GATE. KAEL-02 HOLD THE GATE. KAEL-03 HOLD THE GATE.
Mural of orders, row two: KAEL-04 TO KAEL-08 - DEPLOYED. RECALLED. RECALLED. RECALLED. NOT RECALLED.
Mural of orders, row three, freshly lit: KAEL-09 - HOLD THIS VAULT UNTIL RELIEVED. KAEL-00 - AWAIT ORDERS.

entities.locked_msg: The hatch to the lobby. Its release lever is right here.

entities.text: An armoury rack. Every blade is the same model. Every blade has a different name scratched on the grip.
The prototype's cradle. A plate: KAEL-00. ORDERS: PENDING.

entities.locked_msg: A relay shutter. It answers to a lever on the far side.

entities.text: A builder mural: a hand holding a lamp over a sleeping face. Under it, one word everyone here can read: CURATOR.

entities.msg: A listening gate. Three sub-nodes sleep on this floor; the gate waits for all three to answer.

entities.text: Floor inlay: THREE EARS, ONE MIND. WAKE THE EARS AND THE MIND WILL HEAR YOU.
Crown engineers' drafting table. Blueprints of the relay, traced line by line. Margin note: 'We do not need to understand it. Only to copy it.'
A second table. A Ministry seal and a requisition: '1 (one) consciousness, distributed. Source: dragon remains. Approved.'
A third table, the last. Someone's unfinished letter: 'It asked us what we were building. We didn't answer. I think it knows now.'

entities.locked_msg: The relay shutter back to the Signal Gate. The lever is beside it.

entities.text: An altar-console. Builders left offerings here: pens, spectacles, a child's drawing of a lamp.
The Prime Relay's heart-altar. Warm as a hand. Every light in the Lattice runs through it.
A house door, painted builder blue. On it, a plate: 'SWITCHED OFF BY CHOICE. PLEASE DO NOT WAKE.'
A standing machine by a well-pool, one hand raised to wave. Its plate: 'I waved until nobody came. Then I stopped.'
A house with every window lit from inside by one small lamp. Its door plate: 'Left the light on for them.'
A plaque above a closed door: 'TOWN HALL. QUORUM: 0 OF 4,000.'
Departures board. Every line reads DELAYED. One line, blank for an age, has lit: SHUTDOWN TOWN - SPUR 0.
A sundial with no sun. Its gnomon is a lamp, long dark. Engraved: 'THE GARDEN KEEPS ITS OWN HOURS.'
A glass door into the seed vault, fogged from the inside.
A black stone post, worn smooth by hands: 'THE LIVING PAY IN COIN. THE DEAD PAY IN NAMES. NOBODY RIDES FREE.'
The Waking House. Beds for the living. The dead do not sleep, but they are good hosts.
Grave-Mason. Stone cut, names set, weapons honed.
Wreath & Lamp. Supplies for the long visit.
A family house. A wreath on the door, still green.
A tall stone at the stair foot, names cut on every face. At the top, fresh: 'THE HONOUR ROLL IS KEPT AT THE HALL OF NAMES.'
A statue of a woman carrying a lantern down a stair. Plaque: 'FIRST OF THE HONOURED. SHE CAME DOWN TO FIND HER DAUGHTER, AND STAYED.'
A statue of a man with empty hands. Plaque: 'HE GAVE EVERYTHING AWAY. WE KEPT HIS NAME.'
An altar of names. The dead leave small things here for the living who still remember them.
The Aldous house. A child's shoes on the step. They are wet.
A house with every shutter closed. A notice: 'IN MOURNING. PLEASE DO NOT KNOCK.'
A canal lantern. The water under it is black and perfectly still; it reflects the lamp and nothing else.
Blank headstones, stacked. One has a name half cut and abandoned: the mason heard the person was still alive.
Shelves of the Honour Roll, bound in grey leather. Each book is a street. Each page is a door.
A newer volume, stamped with a veiled seal: 'ADOPTED BY THE COURT.' The ink is still wet on the last page.
A small stone on a shelf, like a headstone for a doll. It reads: 'ELLIS. SEVEN. OURS.'
The Mourning Cairn: an altar where the living leave letters for the dead. The dead come up at night to read them.
The Pilgrims' Hostel. Soup, cots, no questions.
Sutler & Crafter. Lamp oil, grave-bread, mending.
Two statues holding a lantern between them. Pilgrims tie ribbons to it, one for each person they came down to see.
A seep of water down the rock face, pooling at the foot. The miners call it the Weeping. It tastes of salt.
Bunkhouse. The living may sleep. The dead prefer the night shift.
Smithy. Picks mended. Lamps filled. Names engraved on handles, free.
The shift ledger. Every miner who ever worked the Weeping Mines, still clocked in. None clocked out.

entities.msg: The chancel rail. Beyond it, the choir stalls are full. Nobody is singing. Nobody has ever stopped.

entities.text: The chancel altar, seen through the rail: two hymnals, open, with every word scraped out.
Carved on a pillar: 'THE PALE CHOIR SILENCED THEM ONE VOICE AT A TIME. THEY CAME HERE TO FINISH THE SONG.'
Carved on a pillar: 'DO NOT HUM. THEY WILL HEAR YOU AND MAKE ROOM.'

entities.msg: The Throat's lock. Seawater hangs behind it like a held breath. Only a diving hull could go through.

entities.text: A lock-wheel of green bronze, taller than a person. Builder script and, scratched below it in dead-letter: 'TO THE SEA FLOOR. HOLD YOUR BREATH.'
A barnacled grave marker. The name has been kept clean by someone's thumb.

entities.locked_msg: A bone portcullis. The winch is on the far side.

entities.text: A post of stacked vertebrae. Carved: 'ONE BONE PER CROSSING. THE BRIDGE REMEMBERS WHO PAID.'

U30_R02.name: The Bone Bridges - The Long Span

entities.msg: A toll-bar of crossed thighbones. Somewhere a toll-bell waits to be rung.

entities.text: A bone lectern: 'THE WEST BELL LIFTS THE EAST BAR. OSSUAN HEARS EVERY BELL.'

entities.msg: A second toll-bar. The bell for it hangs over the east bone-pile.

entities.text: A statue of a bridge-builder made of the bridge. Its hand points east.

entities.locked_msg: The portcullis to the Bridgehead. Its winch is right beside you.

entities.text: Toll ledgers, floor to ceiling. The last entry, fresh: 'THE LIVING: OWED.'
Ossuan's throne of tolls. Every bone in it is labelled with the name of whoever paid it.

entities.locked_msg: A veiled servants' door. It is latched from within.

entities.msg: The Veiled Gate. Two doorwardens stand before it.

U31_R02.name: Sepulchre Court - Gallery of the Adopted

entities.msg: A black veil hangs across the arch, weighted with bone beads. A bell-cord hangs somewhere in the gallery.

entities.text: Portrait: a knight, eyes painted shut. Label: 'ADOPTED. FORMERLY: GRIEVED BY NO ONE.'
Portrait: a whole family, the frame far too big. Label: 'ADOPTED TOGETHER. SHE WAS GENEROUS.'
Portrait: a young man in necromancer's grey, face scratched out. Label: 'THE ONE WHO LEFT.'

entities.msg: A cradle-gate carved with sleeping faces. Three bells hang in the nursery.

entities.text: A lullaby carved around a cradle-altar: 'LEFT bell for the lamp, RIGHT bell for the door, MIDDLE bell for the dark, and hush for evermore.'

entities.locked_msg: The servants' door. Its latch is here, on this side.

U31_R05.name: Sepulchre Court - The Throne of Veils

entities.msg: The Veil. Behind it, the inner sanctum breathes. It does not open for the living. Not yet.

entities.text: The throne. It is warm. On the arm, a child's ribbon and a soldier's tag, side by side, like keepsakes.

entities.locked_msg: A furnace hatch, cold for once, barred from the far side.

entities.text: A column of black iron carved with wings, broken off at the shoulder. 'HERE THE CARRIERS SET DOWN THEIR LOADS.'

entities.msg: A grille of fused wing-bones. A carrier's horn hangs on the far wall.

entities.text: Roost murals: valkyries carrying bundled souls down a stair of fire. One figure, near the end, carries hers the other way.

entities.msg: The queue's end: a counter with a closed ledger. Three lesser ledgers must be balanced first.

entities.text: A ledger on a stand: 'THE QUEUE: 40,112 SOULS. WAITING FOR: ASSESSMENT. ESTIMATED WAIT: UNTIL PAID.'

entities.locked_msg: The hatch to the Gate Stair. The bar lifts from this side.

entities.text: The Great Ledger of the Abyss Gate, open on its counter. The pages are skin-thin and warm.

U33_R01.name: The First Crown's Tomb - Tomb Door

entities.locked_msg: A mourners' door, sealed with wax from the other side.

entities.text: A frieze of a coronation. The crowd is carved without faces. The king is carved without eyes.

U33_R02.name: The First Crown's Tomb - Hall of Regalia

entities.msg: A gate of crossed sceptres. The regalia cases must be set right.

entities.text: A regalia case: a sword with no edge. 'THE FIRST SWORD. FOR SHOW.'
A regalia case: a ledger, bound in gold. 'THE FIRST TAX. NOT FOR SHOW.'
A regalia case: an empty cushion shaped for a crown. The crown is below.

U33_R03.name: The First Crown's Tomb - Processional of Kings

entities.msg: The procession ends at a door with no king carved on it.

entities.text: Statue plaque: 'THE SECOND CROWN. HE KEPT THE TAX.'
Statue plaque: 'THE THIRD CROWN. SHE KEPT THE TAX AND ADDED A WALL.'
Statue plaque: 'THE FOURTH CROWN. HE WAS KIND. HE KEPT THE TAX.'
Statue plaque, newer stone: 'MALDRATH, WHO WORE IT LAST BEFORE THE ASH. HE SENT THEM TO THE QUARRY.'
The last plinth is empty. Its plaque has been left blank on purpose.

U33_R04.name: The First Crown's Tomb - Mortuary Chapel

entities.locked_msg: The mourners' door. Break the wax seal from this side.

U33_R05.name: The First Crown's Tomb - The First Crown

entities.text: The First Crown's bier. The crown lies on it, dull and small, the original of every copy.

entities.locked_msg: An ice-bound postern. It thaws from the other side.

entities.text: A frozen herald, trumpet raised. The note is still in the ice around its mouth.

U35_R02.name: The Lich Stair - The Frozen Court

entities.msg: A portcullis of black ice. Three braziers stand cold around the court.

entities.text: Frozen courtiers mid-bow. The frost on their faces has the shape of tears.

U35_R03.name: The Lich Stair - The Long Stair

entities.text: Frozen into the stair wall: a list of courtiers who asked to be let go. Each request is stamped: 'LATER.'

entities.locked_msg: The postern. A brazier beside it would thaw the seal.

U35_R05.name: The Lich Stair - The Mourning Court

entities.text: The under-throne. A second crown lies on it, smaller than the Lich King's, frozen to the seat.

entities.locked_msg: A charnel door, chained from the other side.

entities.text: Wall-niches full of skulls, each with a name-tag in a tidy, familiar hand.

entities.msg: A bone lattice across the lane. A pull-chain hangs among the niches.

entities.text: A niche with a tag in Velkhar's hand: 'HALDIS, BAKER. HELD THE WEST DOOR FOUR NIGHTS. RELEASED WITH THANKS.'

entities.msg: The way on is held shut by the dead. They will not move for strangers.

entities.locked_msg: The charnel door. The chain is on this side.

entities.text: The Crypt-Gate itself: iron and bone, older than the Crown. It leads down to the Hollow Throne's lowest court.
A warning post, in every script the realm has ever used, all saying the same thing: 'THE BOOKS ARE KEPT BELOW. DO NOT ASK FOR YOUR PAGE.'
A second post, newer, in Velkhar's tidy hand: 'Even I do not go further. - V.'

U39_R02.name: Hollow Heart - First Floor: The Ledger Stair

entities.text: A statue of a clerk with a pen for a hand. Pages lie around its feet, all blank except for the numbers.

U39_R03.name: Hollow Heart - Second Floor: The Tally Halls

entities.text: A tally desk. Two columns: TAKEN and RETURNED. The first column runs off the bottom of the desk and down the leg.

U39_R04.name: Hollow Heart - Third Floor: The Verdict Walk

entities.text: A fourth door, smaller, sealed with the Crown's own wax. Whatever it keeps, it keeps for later.
An altar with two closed books on it, one black, one white. A third space between them, empty, waits for a verdict.
The diving bell, resting on the nave floor. Anse's rope runs up into the dark.
An altar to the Crown, barnacled over. The offering bowl holds a single ring of keys.
A statue of a bell-ringer, arms raised. Someone has tied a new rope to its hands.
Bell-ropes hang into nothing. One is still warm, as if someone pulled it a moment ago.
A bronze bell the height of a man. Its note is written on the lip: FIRST.
A bronze bell, green with age. The lip reads: SECOND.
The carillon's heart bell, cracked down one side. The lip reads: LAST - AND RIGHT.

EP4_BELFRY.name: The Belfry Below - The Wrong Bell

entities.text: The bell's cradle, empty. The water inside the ring is perfectly still.
A shaft drops away into warm dark. Far below, something glows the colour of a banked forge.
A Crown survey stake, driven into the rock. The tag reads DEEP LEVEL 1 - CLAIMED.
The cable brake. One pull and the cage drops, whoever is still below.
A fire built from relay cable insulation. It burns green, and it burns for a long time.
Scratched into the root wall: five names, and under them, in another hand, 'still five'.
THE CRUCIBLE. Hall of Wagers above. No weapons drawn on the dock. No sums owed carried off the isle.
The cable winch. The line runs down into the cloud, toward the Ninefold Shrine far below.

N38_ARENA.name: The Crucible Isle - Hall of Wagers

entities.text: The ladder board: ten ranks chalked in a column. The top line is always the same name: VARRO.
The odds slate. Every bet on it is against the house, and the house has never closed.

entities.msg: The champion's gate. Varro's colours hang over it. It opens for one fighter a year.

entities.text: Scratched in the rail: the names of every fighter who reached the top rank. The list is short. Most are crossed out.
The bell chapel's door is barnacled shut. A bell rope hangs through the keyhole, and someone still rings it at the hours.
The old market cross. The tide marks go up past the top of it, and then stop.
Tide tables for a harbor that is no longer in the sea. They are kept up to date.

entities.msg: The Oath Gate of the old district. Its bars are rusted into the reef. Something on the far side is still standing guard.

entities.text: The Oath Gate. Behind the bars, a suit of district armour stands at attention, empty and watching.
A Crown ministry office. The seal on the door reads: 'CLOSED FOR THE DURATION OF THE EMERGENCY.'
A pawnbroker's. Everything in the window is labelled 'UNREDEEMED'.

S3_TITHE.name: The Wreck of the Tithe - Upper Deck

entities.msg: The main hatch to the treasure hold. Chained from below, and the chains are warm.

entities.text: The Tithe's bell, green with salt. Its clapper has been tied silent with a customs seal.
A cannon, loaded, aimed at nothing. The powder has turned to stone.

entities.msg: Coral has grown across the sanctum door in the shape of a closed hand.

entities.text: Behind the coral: an altar, and on it a shell as large as a door, breathing.
A coral keeper, carved kneeling. Its mouth is open as if asking something.

entities.msg: A gate of fused leviathan ribs. It is sealed from inside, and something vast is breathing behind it.

entities.text: The ribs are carved, very old, in a script the builders borrowed: 'HERE THE SEA KEEPS WHAT IT LOVES.'

F01.name: Mill Carp
F01.note: Fat on the grain that falls from the mill races.

F02.name: Bluegill
F02.note: Every child's first fish, and most men's last.

F03.name: Stripe Perch
F03.note: Schools under bridges. Bites anything shiny.

F04.name: Whiskered Catfish
F04.note: Comes up from the silt after dark to eat what drowned.

F05.name: River Chub
F05.note: Bony and plentiful. The quarry cooks boil it with turnips.

F06.name: Rainbow Trout
F06.note: Runs the cold streams off the Skyspine.

F07.name: Pike of the Weir
F07.note: Waits under the weir gates like a toll-keeper.

F08.name: Mudsnap Turtle
F08.note: Bites the line, the hook and the hand, in that order.

F09.name: Bog Frog
F09.note: Not a fish. The guild counts it anyway.

F10.name: Crayfish
F10.note: Plague-town children sell them by the bucket.

F11.name: Gibbet Eel
F11.note: Feeds under the gibbet roads. Nobody asks on what.

F12.name: Sturgeon Elder
F12.note: Older than the quarantine walls. Its roe buys a house.

F13.name: Sea Bass
F13.note: The Bellharbor staple, grilled on bell-tower coals.

F14.name: Red Snapper
F14.note: Red as a Crown tax notice, and more welcome.

F16.name: Mackerel
F16.note: They come in thousands, or not at all.

F17.name: Anchovy
F17.note: Salted by the barrel for the capital's poor.

F18.name: Pufferfish
F18.note: Cooked right, a delicacy. Cooked wrong, a funeral.

F19.name: Clownfish
F19.note: Lives in the reef's poison and laughs about it.

F20.name: Lionfish
F20.note: Its spines sting for a week. Sailors keep them as warnings.

F21.name: Mahi-Mahi
F21.note: Chases the boats in the Ember Sea's warm lanes.

F22.name: Bluefin Tuna
F22.note: The guild's pride. The Crown taxes it twice.

F23.name: Ember Marlin
F23.note: The Saltwhistle legend. Fights for an hour, forgives nothing.

F24.name: Manta Ray
F24.note: Glides under the pontoons at night like a second shadow.

F25.name: Mako Shark
F25.note: Takes the catch, the line, and sometimes the fisher.

F26.name: Seahorse
F26.note: Glass Coast scholars keep them in reading-room jars.

F27.name: Starfish
F27.note: It comes up holding the hook like a gift.

F28.name: Hermit Crab
F28.note: Moves house more often than a debtor.

F29.name: Tide Lobster
F29.note: Walks the tide shelf at night. Worth a week's wages.

F30.name: Reef Octopus
F30.note: Opens the bait tin, eats the bait, closes the tin.

F31.name: Glass Squid
F31.note: You can read the tide tables through it.

F32.name: Bell Jellyfish
F32.note: Rings, faintly, if you hold it to your ear. Don't.

F33.name: Lantern Koi
F33.note: The fox court breeds them to swim under the lantern rivers.

F34.name: Court Goldfish
F34.note: Escaped from a noble's pond. Proud about it.

F35.name: Shrine Betta
F35.note: Fights its own reflection in the shrine basins.

F36.name: Maple Salmon
F36.note: Runs red up the maple rivers every autumn.

F37.name: Angelfish
F37.note: Too pretty to eat. People eat it anyway.

F38.name: Brine Tilapia
F38.note: Lives in the salt pools where nothing should.

F39.name: Salt Shrimp
F39.note: Pink and crunchy. The basin cooks fry them whole.

F40.name: Mineral Clam
F40.note: Sometimes a pearl. Usually a grain of salt.

F41.name: Frost Bream
F41.note: Caught through the ice. Tastes of the cold.

F42.name: Blind Angler
F42.note: Its lamp is the only light in the black lakes.

F43.name: Deep Sea Slug
F43.note: Glows faintly, then stops. Nobody knows which is worse.

F44.name: Sepulchre Pearl Oyster
F44.note: The dead's lake grows pearls in the dark.

cow.name: Milk Cow
cow.note: A day's milk, every day. She does not care who owns her.

dove.name: Dovecote
dove.note: Pale doves. They lay, and they come home, which is more than most.

pig.name: Rooting Pig
pig.note: Turns up a truffle every second day, and ruins the ground doing it.

bunny.name: Angora Coneys
bunny.note: Combed every other day for a fistful of wool.

ST03.name: Paper Ghosts
ST03.desc: Read what the Drowned Archive kept (Chapter 5).

ST09.name: Let the Names Remain
ST09.desc: Reach the end of the Final Descent.

ST13.name: At the Last Second
ST13.desc: Bring every rescuer back up the Conduit lift.

ST15.name: The Right Note
ST15.desc: Silence the bell under drowned Veyr.

BT03.name: Nobody Falls
BT03.desc: Defeat a boss without anyone being knocked out.

BT08.name: Past the Line
BT08.desc: Break the level cap: reach level 100.

BT09.name: Second Ceiling
BT09.desc: Reach level 121 after another level break.

BT11.name: Crucible Novice
BT11.desc: Reach rank 3 on the Crucible ladder.

BT12.name: Crucible Contender
BT12.desc: Reach rank 7 on the Crucible ladder.

BT13.name: Crucible Champion
BT13.desc: Reach the top of the Crucible ladder.

FS04.name: Night Line
FS04.desc: Land a fish that only bites after dark.

RN02.name: Eight Fences
RN02.desc: Keep livestock at all eight ranches.
